item.title: 台湾東方での中国哨戒活動、米議会諮問委トップ「不安定化招く」
item.description:
Ben Blanchard
[台北 ２０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Ben Blanchard

[台北 ２０日 ロイター] - 米議会の諮問機関「米中経済安全保障調査委員会」のランドール・シュライバー委員長は２０日、台湾で開催されたフォーラムで、台湾東方での中国海警局のパトロールは「極めて不安定化を招く」ものとの認識を示した。

中国は６月以降、台湾東海岸沖での活動を強化し、海警局による定期的な哨戒活動を行っている。

シュライバー氏は「これは法的戦争、そして政治的な情報戦争の延長線上にある。もし中国がこの法執行の役割を継続して果たし続けるならば、極めて不安定化を招くことになるだろう」と述べた。

また、年内に米中首脳会談がさらに２回見込まれる中、米国による台湾への新たな武器パッケージに関する動きは来年になってからになるだろうと付け加えた。

中国外務省はコメント要請に応じていない。

同イベントで発言した台湾国家安全会議の呉釗燮秘書長は、中国には台湾東方の海域に対する法的権利はないと述べた。

item.title: Two-run homers send Rays past Guardians in Game 6, into World Series
item.description: ST. PETERSBURG, Fla. -- The Tampa Bay Rays are headed back to the World Series, 18 years to the day since they captured the first American League pennant in franchise history.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: ST. PETERSBURG, Fla. -- The Tampa Bay Rays are headed back to the World Series, 18 years to the day since they captured the first American League pennant in franchise history. Junior Caminero and Yandy Diaz each belted a two-run homer, helping Tampa Bay advance to the World Series for the third time in franchise history with a 7-3 victory over the Cleveland Guardians on Monday. The Rays recorded their third straight win to capture the American League Championship Series in six games. Tampa Bay will visit Milwaukee for Game 1 of the World Series on Friday. The Brewers won two of the three games against the visiting Rays in the regular season in a series played March 30-April 1. Tampa Bay was unsuccessful in its previous two trips to the Fall Classic. The Rays fell in five games to the Philadelphia Phillies in 2008 and in six games to the Los Angeles Dodgers in 2020. Caminero celebrated his first career postseason homer by emphatically slapping his chest before rounding first base and posing with his arms folded at home plate. The latter gesture was a nod to former Tampa Bay slugger Randy Arozarena, who was in the crowd on Monday at Tropicana Field. "Tampa, this is for you," Caminero screamed during his postgame interview with TNT Sports, doing his best LeBron James imitation after the latter helped the Cleveland Cavaliers win the 2016 NBA Finals. Diaz, who guaranteed after Game 5 that "we're going to win tomorrow," provided the exclamation point in the eighth inning on Monday with a homer over the left field wall. "A lot of people didn't believe me, but here are the results," Diaz said of predicting the Game 6 victory. Diaz was signed by Cleveland in 2013 out of Cuba and traded to Tampa Bay in 2018. Caminero was signed by Cleveland in 2019 out of the Dominican Republic and traded to Tampa Bay in 2021. Tampa Bay's Richie Palacios, who also began his career with Cleveland, laced a two-run double into the right-center-field gap in the second inning to open the scoring. That was enough offense for Freddy Peralta (2-0), who allowed one run on five hits and three walks while striking out three in 5 1/3 innings. He went 2-0 in three appearances (two starts) during the series, yielding one run on nine hits in 12 innings while striking out nine to earn ALCS MVP honors. "This is for the boys," Peralta said after being presented with the award. Cleveland's Nathaniel Lowe had an RBI single in the sixth inning, and Rays reliever Ian Seymour issued a bases-loaded walk to Patrick Bailey and then hit Angel Martinez with his next pitch to trim Tampa Bay's lead to 5-3 in the eighth. Kevin Kelly relieved Seymour and struck out Brayan Rocchio on three pitches to end the inning. After Diaz's blast restored the Rays' four-run lead, Bryan Baker retired the side in order in the ninth to end the game. "Let it hurt. Let it sink in. Let it fuel you this winter," Guardians manager Stephen Vogt said of his message to his players. Caminero chased Cleveland opener Shawn Armstrong (0-1) with a single to lead off the second inning. Chandler Simpson reached on a fielder's choice off Tim Herrin and promptly stole second base. Victor Mesa Jr. walked before both runners advanced a base and later scored on Palacios' double. Armstrong allowed one run on one hit in one-plus innings. Herrin permitted one run on one hit in two-thirds of an inning. Tampa Bay tacked on in the third inning when Caminero scored on Jonny DeLuca's sacrifice fly for a 3-0 lead. --Field Level Media

item.title: Promoter challenges decision in WBA lightweight title bout over 'officiating errors'
item.description: Boxing promoter Most Valuable Promotions has challenged the decision to award Floyd Schofield a unanimous victory over Lucas Bahdi in their WBA lightweight title bout in Chicago this month, saying significant officiating errors impacted the outcome.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Boxing promoter Most Valuable Promotions has challenged the decision to award Floyd Schofield a unanimous victory over Lucas Bahdi in their WBA lightweight title bout in Chicago this month, saying significant officiating errors impacted the outcome. American Schofield came out a 115-111, 116-110, 119-108 winner on the judges' scorecards on October 10. He was left on the canvas after tangling with Canadian Bahdi in the third, sixth and ninth rounds, but the referee did not rule those as knockdowns. "The video evidence demonstrates multiple significant officiating errors that directly impacted the outcome of the fight," Most Valuable Promotions said in a statement on Monday. "Our review shows that had these knockdowns been properly ruled and scored, Lucas would have won the WBA lightweight world championship by majority decision. "We have a responsibility to advocate for our fighters, especially when a world championship is at stake." Schofield's promoter Golden Boy Promotions and the World Boxing Association did not immediately respond to requests for comment outside regular business hours in North America.

Singapore tech giant Sea plans IPO for financial services arm Monee, memo says

The memo said the tech group would also launch an AI-first enterprise platform named Sea Cloud.

FAST

SINGAPORE: Singapore-headquartered tech conglomerate Sea Limited is planning a public listing for its financial services arm Monee and will also launch an AI enterprise platform business, according to an internal memo sent on Tuesday (Oct 20). Founder Forrest Li, in a memo to employees that was reviewed by Reuters, said he believed going public would give its financial payments and services business the "resources and the room to go further and faster than it can today”.  The business operates in Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, the Philippines, Taiwan, and Brazil and offers mobile wallets, payments processing, credit and banking services. Sea did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The memo said the tech group would also launch an AI-first enterprise platform named Sea Cloud.  In the memo, which was sent on the ninth anniversary of the group’s public listing in New York, Li said the quarterly revenue for the group had grown more than 80 times over that period to US$7.8 billion.

item.title: トランプ氏、農家向け80億ドル支援発表 ディーゼル燃料費を補填
item.description:
Bo Erickson Kanishka Singh
[パークシティ（米カンザス州） １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Bo Erickson　Kanishka Singh

[パークシティ（米カンザス州） １９日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１９日、米農務省が収穫期におけるディーゼル燃料費を補填するため、農家に８０億ドルの支援を提供する新たなプログラムを開始すると述べた。

トランプ氏はカンザス州で行った中間選挙関連の演説で「今夜、農務省が新たな『収穫期燃料支援プログラム』を開始し、今シーズンの収穫期間中のディーゼル燃料費を補填するため、農家に８０億ドルの支援を提供する政策を発表できることを嬉しく思う」と述べた。

物価高が進む中、トランプ氏と共和党は、上院選の接戦が予想される農業州での支持維持に奔走している。

トランプ氏は今月初め、免税ディーゼル（軽油）燃料の利用拡大に関する大統領令に署名した。

農務省は１９日のトランプ氏の演説後、「一時的な市場の混乱や生産コストの上昇に伴う救済措置として、今収穫期に米国の農家への一時金として８０億ドルを拠出する」と発表した。

item.title: アマゾン、独自ＡＩ半導体普及に向け新ソフト導入へ エヌビディア優位に対抗
item.description:
Stephen Nellis
[サンフランシスコ １９日 ロイター] - 米アマゾン・ドット・コムは、独自開発した人工...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アマゾン、独自ＡＩ半導体普及に向け新ソフト導入へ　エヌビディア優位に対抗 13:38 配信

写真は人工知能（ＡＩ）のイメージ。10月19日に撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Stephen Nellis

[サンフランシスコ １９日 ロイター] - 米アマゾン・ドット・コムは、独自開発した人工知能（ＡＩ）半導体上で、最も広く使われているＡＩ開発フレームワーク「PyTorch」で書かれたコードをほぼ無修正で実行できる新たなソフトウエアを導入する。ＡＩコンピューティング市場で圧倒的な地位を築くエヌビディア の競争上の優位を切り崩すのが狙い。

アマゾンの半導体部門アンナプルナ・ラボによると、新ソフト「TorchNeuron」を使えば、開発者は設定を１カ所変更するだけで、PyTorchで書かれたコードをアマゾンのＡＩ半導体「Trainium」上で実行できる。コードを書き直す必要はないという。

アマゾンは１９日にシリコンバレーで開く開発者向け会議で新ソフトを発表する予定。このソフトは無料のオープンソース型として一般公開するという。

PyTorchはメタ・プラットフォームズが管理するオープンソースのフレームワークで、ＡＩ開発者の大半が利用している。エヌビディアは、PyTorchのコードを自社製半導体上で効率よく動作させるソフト開発基盤「CUDA」の開発に１０年余りを費やしてきた。

アンナプルナ・ラボのソフトウエア担当副社長コリン・ブレース氏は今回の取り組みについて、開発者がアマゾン独自の半導体を試すまでに必要な手順を減らすことが目的だと説明。「顧客が現在利用している環境に合わせることが狙いだ」と述べた。

ブレース氏によると、ロボティクス、ワールドモデル（現実世界の挙動を学習・予測するＡＩ）、音声ＡＩなどの分野にまたがる３０社余りの先行顧客がすでに新ソフトを利用している。アマゾンの半導体に切り替えることで大幅なコスト削減につながるという。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず 最終更新: 10/20(火) 13:38 ロイター

item.title: Morning Bid: Korean canary in the AI coalmine
item.description: A look at the day ahead in European and global markets from Rocky Swift
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A look at the day ahead in European and global markets from Rocky Swift A rocky [USN:L1N46600F TEXT:"start"] for a South Korean startup cast a shadow over highly anticipated announcements by AI hyperscalers this week. AI infrastructure company Elice Group (0158S0.KQ) sank nearly 30% below its initial public offering price on Tuesday, while the tech-heavy KOSPI (.KS11) gauge lost nearly 4%, showing shaky sentiment after a market selloff that derailed some deals. Along with quarterly results, the massive [USN:L8N4651G6 TEXT:"spending plans"] of the major AI players are increasingly in focus. Facebook operator Meta Platforms (META.O) , due to report on Wednesday, is one of five AI hyperscalers expected to increase combined capital expenditure to about $1.2 trillion next year, according to Goldman Sachs. As infrastructure plans grow ever larger and borrowing costs soar, investors are questioning "whether every dollar of AI capex earns more than it costs to finance," said Ninghui Liu, head of investment strategy and research for APAC at State Street Investment Management. On the docket today, Netflix (NFLX.O) is expected to report slowing revenue growth in the third quarter, while SpaceX (SPCX.O) is forecast to report $12.74 billion in quarterly revenue. General Motors (GM.N) , Hasbro (HAS.O) , Halliburton (HAL.N) , and 3M (MMM.N) are among the more-established names due to report on Tuesday. Oil prices resumed their [USN:L1N46601X TEXT:"climb"] on Tuesday as it seemed unclear whether US President Donald Trump would go through with a waiver of [USN:L1N463009 TEXT:"sanctions"] on some Russian energy exports, while fresh [USN:L1N46509O TEXT:"violence"] in the Middle East heightened the risk of supply disruptions. Inflationary pressures from elevated oil prices have put most major central banks on a tightening bias, though with a careful eye on whether economies are resilient enough to absorb higher interest rates. Recent comments from Federal Reserve officials, including Chair Kevin Warsh, suggest policymakers are in no rush to hike rates again. European Central Bank policymaker Martin Kocher is due to speak later on Tuesday, as well as ECB policymaker and Finnish central bank governor Olli Rehn. Bank of England Monetary Policy Committee member Megan Greene will deliver a speech at the London School of Economics. In the economic data calendar, the US Census Bureau is expected to say housing starts rose to 1.305 million in September from 1.275 million in August, while building permits may have increased to 1.395 million from 1.403 million. In early European trades, the pan-region Euro Stoxx 50 futures were down 0.63%, German DAX futures sank 0.39% and FTSE futures were down 0.48%. US stock futures, the S&P 500 e-minis , were up 0.1% at 7,742. Key developments that could influence markets on Tuesday: - Earnings: Deutsche Boerse AG, Netflix, RTX, SpaceX, General Electric, 3M, General Motors, Hasbro - Germany Producer Prices for September - United Kingdom jobs data for August - Euro zone current account (August) - ZEW Surveys for euro zone, Germany - Auctions: Germany – Reopening of 3-year and 27-year government debt; United Kingdom – Reopening of 10-year government debt

item.title: 人民元が4年超ぶり高値、輸出好調と元高の基準値で＝上海外為市場
item.description: [香港 ２０日 ロイター] - 上海外国為替市場の人民元相場は対ドルで４年余りぶりの高値を付けた。中国人民銀行（中央銀...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
人民元が4年超ぶり高値、輸出好調と元高の基準値で＝上海外為市場 13:37 配信

中国人民元と米ドルの紙幣。22年9月撮影。REUTERS/Florence Lo

[香港 ２０日 ロイター] - 上海外国為替市場の人民元相場は対ドルで４年余りぶりの高値を付けた。中国人民銀行（中央銀行）が基準値（中間値）を元高方向に設定したことに加え、好調な輸出を背景にした企業の決済需要が相場を押し上げた。

オンショア人民元は午前の取引で一時１ドル＝６．６７８９元まで上昇し、２０２２年６月２８日以来の高値を付けた。

オフショア人民元は約０．０５％高の１ドル＝６．６７８７元で取引され、こちらも４年余りぶりの高値となった。

中国の第３・四半期経済成長率は４．５％と、約３年ぶりの低水準だった第２・四半期の４．３％から加速。市場予想を上回った。国内消費が低迷する中でも、輸出と鉱工業生産が引き続き成長をけん引した。

人民銀行は２０日、銀行貸出金利の指標となる最優遇貸出金利（ローンプライムレート、ＬＰＲ）を市場の予想通り１７カ月連続で据え置いた。堅調な国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）統計を受け、政策当局が追加金融緩和を急いでいないことを示した。

格付け会社、中証鵬元のアナリストはリポートで「今回の人民元上昇を最も直接的に支えているのは、貿易部門の好調だ」と指摘した。

人民元の上昇基調が続く中、企業が外貨から元への両替を加速させ、元高の勢いを強めていると説明。元は今後も緩やかに上昇し、年末までに１ドル＝６．６０─６．７０元のレンジで取引されると予想した。

人民銀は市場の取引開始前に、対ドル基準値を１ドル＝６．７２元に設定した。２３年２月２日以来の元高水準となった。ただロイターの推計と比べると３８７ポイントの元安だった。

item.title: Coach of England's test team should be English, says New Zealander Fleming
item.description: Stephen Fleming is the fifth foreign coach to take charge of England's test team but the New Zealander hopes his successors will be English and says he will seek to develop home-grown coaching talent during his tenure.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Stephen Fleming is the fifth foreign coach to take charge of England's test team but the New Zealander hopes his successors will be English and says he will seek to develop home-grown coaching talent during his tenure. Fleming [USN:L1N43W0FU TEXT:"was appointed in July"] to replace compatriot Brendon McCullum, with Australian Trevor Bayliss and Zimbabwe's Duncan Fletcher and Andy Flower the other foreign coaches to have been at the helm of the test side. "I do believe that primarily the national team should be coached by a national representative," Fleming told the BBC in a podcast released on Monday. "I'm grateful for the opportunity, but there will be some development in terms of the coaching, and you can see by our staff," added the 53-year-old, who named former England players Marcus Trescothick, Richard Dawson and James Foster among his backroom staff last week. Fleming also highlighted the importance of having a good working relationship with former New Zealand teammate McCullum, who remains in charge of England's limited-overs team, with the Ashes and Cricket World Cup looming next year. "At some stage you're going to have to give up some of your key assets. We look at what's coming up, there's a test series for us against South Africa," he said. "We then move to the Ashes, which is obviously the milestone event for the summer next year, and then there's the World Cup. "Making sure that the players are as fit as can be for each of those marquee events and that we turn out good sides is going to be a challenge." England visit South Africa in a three-test series beginning in December.

item.title: Europe's earnings boom widens beyond energy and AI
item.description: European companies are expected to deliver another quarter of exceptional earnings growth, again driven mainly by profits at energy companies and those pivotal to the datacentre buildout, although signs are emerging of strength elsewhere.
item.dc:creator: Samuel Indyk
item.content:encoded: European companies are expected to deliver another quarter of exceptional earnings growth, again driven mainly by profits at energy companies and those pivotal to the datacentre buildout, although signs are emerging of strength elsewhere. Third-quarter earnings for the pan-regional STOXX 600 (.STOXX) are expected to grow 20.7% from a year ago, according to LSEG I/B/E/S, a slowdown from the second-quarter pace of 24%, but still among the fastest in years. With over half of the index's market capitalisation reporting over the next two weeks, here is what you need to know as the earnings season begins: 1/ WHERE ARE THE DOWNGRADES? In the past, analysts have typically cut earnings estimates ahead of reporting season. This time, in aggregate, they have raised forecasts, suggesting better-than-expected growth, optimism over AI spending and elevated energy prices will lead to stronger profit growth. "Some of these dynamics look a little different than usual," David Groman, global equity strategist at Citi, said, adding they were "unseasonably strong and unusually broad". Pre-earnings upgrades could make investors focus less on whether companies beat their third-quarter estimates and more on their outlook for the fourth quarter and beyond for clues on whether momentum can continue. 2/ ALL ABOUT AI Europe lacks AI big-hitters, such as Nvidia (NVDA.O) , Alphabet (GOOGL.O) or Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) , but it has many smaller hardware stocks, materials and industrials that are benefiting from the capex boom. Tech earnings are forecast to increase by almost 33% from a year ago, according to LSEG I/B/E/S, while industrials profits are expected to rise by 11%. "It's often said Europe doesn't really have any AI plays but we think you can pick through French and German industrials," said Dorian Carrell, head of multi-asset income at Schroders. "Expectations there have been tempered over the last few weeks, but there is a chance for European industrials to surpass expectations." 3/ ENERGY BOOST The rise in oil and gas prices internationally since the outbreak of the US-Iran war has increased inflation and is a cost for many, but it has also boosted earnings expectations for companies that can benefit. "The big reason for the continued upgrades for earnings this year in Europe has been the tailwind from energy prices," Barclays equity strategists said. That support could fade if tensions in the Middle East ease and energy prices retreat, or if sustained high prices curb demand, turning the energy sector from a boost to a drag on broader earnings growth. "We expect refining-geared names to outperform, and we think the question now is: how long this lasts," Barclays added. 4/ BANKING BOUNCE? Europe's banks, one of the best-performing sectors in global equities over the last four years, have come under pressure from political concerns, but analysts do not anticipate a poor earnings season. Europe's bank index (.SX7P) is down 7% since the start of September, compared to a 1.7% drop for the broader STOXX 600, offering a lower bar to clear. The sector trades at about 10 times its forward earnings, which are expected to grow at about 8% over the medium term, a backdrop that should support the sector going forward, according to Schroders' Carrell, especially as recent volatility has depressed expectations. "The capital positions are strong, but the key thing is the lending activity picking up," Carrell said. "Everything points to European banks being in a good place." 5/ CONSUMER RESILIENCE Worries about consumers lacking spending power have lingered in Europe for years, but Maximilian Uleer, head of European equity and cross-asset strategy at Deutsche Bank, is upbeat. Trading at 13.6 times forward earnings, Europe's consumer staples sector (.S600CSP) trades at a 35% discount to its US counterpart, which Uleer thinks is too low. "I prefer European staples over US staples, because of the valuation difference and similar earnings profile," Uleer said. The European staples sector is expected to grow earnings by over 7% in the third quarter. "There's good reason to believe that the consumer is more resilient than we think, especially in Europe, and that's why we like staples. I think people will be surprised by more positive numbers."

item.title: 豪ＮＡＢ、コスト削減で2500人削減へ 信用鈍化で
item.description:
Scott Murdoch Rajasik Mukherjee
[シドニー ２０日 ロイター] - 豪大手行ナショナル...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
豪ＮＡＢ、コスト削減で2500人削減へ　信用鈍化で 13:28 配信

ＮＡＢのロゴ。シドニー市内の支店で25年8月撮影。REUTERS/Hollie Adams

Scott Murdoch　Rajasik Mukherjee

[シドニー ２０日 ロイター] - 豪大手行ナショナル・オーストラリア銀行（ＮＡＢ）は２０日、国内の信用拡大が依然として厳しい状況にある中、業務の簡素化とコスト削減を図るため、来年までに最大２５００人（従業員総数の約６％）を削減すると発表した。

オーストラリア最大の企業向け融資機関であり、住宅ローン分野では第３位のＮＡＢは、年内に最大１５００人のポストを削減すると述べた。

削減の対象は、顧客対応を行う銀行員よりも、法人向け業務に従事する従業員が中心となるという。

また、コンサルタントや契約社員の活用も大幅に削減する計画だ。

アンドリュー・アーバイン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は声明で、「当社の目標と戦略に変更はない。生産性、リスク管理、業務遂行力を向上させ、よりシンプルで効率的な銀行となる」と述べた。

ＮＡＢの株価はこの日、２．５％近く下落した。

ＮＡＢはまた、金融セクター労働組合との協議を開始すると発表した。同組合幹部のニコール・マクファーソン氏は、人員削減は組織の簡素化にはつながらないと指摘した上で「クリスマスを目前に控えたこの時期に、従業員数の６％を解雇するという破壊的な措置を講じることは恥ずべきことであり、ＮＡＢの経営陣が従業員の実際の生活実態から完全に乖離していることを示している」と批判した。

ＮＡＢはこの大改革により、２７年には、人員削減、配置転換、組織再編にかかる費用として、税引前約３億オーストラリアドル（２億９００万米ドル）の再編費用が発生する見込みだ。

今回の人員削減は、住宅市場の低迷、競争の激化、および運営コストの上昇が収益を圧迫する中、オーストラリアの銀行各社に対する圧力が高まっていた状況を受けて行われたものだ。

ＮＡＢは８月、連邦政府による不動産税改革を受けて、２７年には住宅ローンの伸びが急激に鈍化すると警告していた。同行は、この改革が住宅購入者や投資家からの需要を冷え込ませたと指摘していた。

アーバイン氏は当時、地政学的な不確実性、国内金利の上昇、税制改正が相まって、顧客にとっての課題となっていると述べていた。

ＮＡＢの最新の年次報告書によると、２５年９月３０日時点で、同銀行は世界全体で４万１８８０人を雇用していた。

item.title: Too much of a good scent? Hanoi curbs iconic trees
item.description: Vietnam's capital Hanoi has launched a large-scale programme to prune hundreds of its iconic blackboard trees and is considering relocating some after their distinctive fragrance proved too much for some residents.
item.dc:creator: Khanh Vu, Phuong Nguyen
item.content:encoded: Vietnam's capital Hanoi has launched a large-scale programme to prune hundreds of its iconic blackboard trees and is considering relocating some after their distinctive fragrance proved too much for some residents. Known in Vietnamese as hoa sua, meaning "milk flower", and also known as pulai and devil's tree elsewhere in Asia, blackboard trees can grow as tall as 60 metres (197 feet). The name reflects the traditional use of its wood for school items, as does its scientific name, Alstonia scholaris. Blackboard trees have lined Hanoi's boulevards since they were introduced during French colonial rule in the late 19th century. They were later planted across the capital, and Hanoi now has about 14,400 of the trees, according to the city government. At dusk, the trees release a pungent, sweet scent from their greenish-white flowers, peaking in September and October. Long associated with the arrival of autumn in Hanoi, they have inspired hit songs and poetry for decades. But many of the city's nearly 9 million residents say the fragrance is overpowering. "I simply cannot stand the smell," said Hanoi resident Nguyen Ha Long, 43, who said he stopped his evening runs because the scent gave him migraines. TRIMMING 7% OF TREES After years of complaints and smaller interventions, local authorities have launched their largest pruning campaign yet, stripping the flowers from about 7% of Hanoi's blackboard trees during a five-day blitz ending on Tuesday. Officials also plan to relocate trees from streets where they are most heavily concentrated, adding to the impact of major public works projects underway in Hanoi that are rapidly reshaping the city's landscape as the ruling Communist Party chases ultra-fast economic growth. Not everybody backs the move. "I absolutely love the scent of blackboard trees. The stronger the fragrance, the more I love it," said Nguyen Thu Trang, 37, who lives on central Nguyen Du, a street lined with blackboard trees and which was also the setting of the best-selling novel "The Sorrow of War". "My family has lived here for over 30 years, and we all love the scent. I feel deeply saddened seeing the city prune them," she added. "The smell is not toxic," said Tran Cong Khanh, head of Vietnam's ethnomedicine research centre, echoing views expressed by three other Vietnamese scientists interviewed by Reuters, who however recommend limiting concentrations in densely populated areas because the pollen, like that of other plants, can trigger allergic reactions. The debate has been widely reported by local newspapers, despite public health rarely ranking among Vietnamese residents' top concerns. By contrast, air pollution, which often makes Hanoi one of the [USN:L5N3FR0LA TEXT:"world's most polluted cities "]during winter, has generally attracted less public attention.

item.title: ‘It was crazy’: Australian barber hailed as hero after rushing to lawmaker’s rescue
item.description: Australian barber Ricky Jefferies said he ran to assist lawmaker Helen Haines, grabbing a knife from the alleged attacker's pocket and pulling him out of the car.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

‘It was crazy’: Australian barber hailed as hero after rushing to lawmaker’s rescue

Australian barber Ricky Jefferies said he ran to assist lawmaker Helen Haines, grabbing a knife from the alleged attacker's pocket and pulling him out of the car.

Barber Ricky Jefferies speaks to the media a day after tackling a man who attacked Australian politician Helen Haines in the northern regional city of Wangaratta on Oct 20, 2026. (Photo: AFP/William West)

FAST

SYDNEY: Australian barber Ricky Jefferies has been hailed as a hero for running out of his store to detain a man who authorities allege deliberately drove a car into lawmaker Helen Haines in the small town of Wangaratta, an incident that has shocked the country.    Jefferies had just finished haircuts for a young family on Monday (Oct 19) when he said he heard a "loud bang" outside his shop and realised the driver of a Toyota LandCruiser had struck Haines, leaving her badly injured. "It was crazy, I just ran out the front to see what was happening," he told reporters on Tuesday. He said he ran to assist the well-respected local MP, grabbing a knife from the alleged attacker's pocket and pulling him out of the car.

"He did have a knife. He didn't pull it out. I just wasn't comfortable with his movements, and so I basically just took it out of his pocket and threw it away," he said. Jefferies said he then held the man down until police arrived. "I just leant over him and once he was on the ground and he was no longer a threat, I just stood with him and I told him that he can't leave," he said.

Members of the police stand guard at the crime scene of a vehicle attack on Australian lawmaker Helen Haines in Wangaratta, Australia on Oct 19, 2026 in this screen grab obtained from a video. (Photo: Australian Broadcasting Corporation via Reuters)

Haines, 65, was airlifted to hospital where she underwent surgery overnight. She remains in a critical condition.  Early investigations suggested the driver, identified as a 43-year-old man, performed a U-turn before hitting Haines as she was loading or unloading things from the trunk of her car, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said . Counterterrorism authorities are among the multiple agencies involved in the investigation. While police have given no motive for the alleged attack, the involvement of counterterrorism investigators has raised alarm that it could have been an act of political violence, which is rare in Australia. Jefferies, whose shop is next door to Haines' electorate office around three hours' drive northeast of Melbourne, described the former midwife as a "genuine, kind person". Albanese praised Jefferies' intervention, calling him a hero. "At this dark and terrible time, an element of light is the fact that a Good Samaritan, someone rushed to Helen's defence in Wangaratta, put themselves potentially at risk by doing so. And that person is a hero today," Albanese said in an interview with the Nine network's "Today" show.  Jefferies downplayed the praise. "I don't think I'm a hero. I think that I just was a person who had an opportunity to intervene in a safe-ish sort of way," he said.

item.title: Green card, no vote: Two Indians face US election fraud charges
item.description: Kaur, a resident of Rancho Palos Verdes who is seeking US citizenship, allegedly registered to vote in December 2022 and cast a ballot in the November 2024 election. The department has said that the ...
item.dc:creator: Sunainaa Chadha
item.content:encoded: Two Indian nationals, Amandeep Kaur, 30, and Kamlesh Shah, 67, are among 28 lawful permanent residents charged with alleged election-related offences in California, according to the US Department of Justice (DOJ). The charges relate to allegedly registering to vote or casting ballots in US elections despite not being US citizens.  The charges were announced on October 19 as part of “Operation Protect the Vote”, a coordinated enforcement initiative involving all four US attorney’s offices in California. Federal authorities said 11 of the 28 accused were arrested in early-morning operations across the state. The DOJ's announcement did not establish whether Kaur and Shah were among those arrested.  The allegations are criminal charges, not findings of guilt. The case also comes amid a wider dispute between the Trump administration and California officials over the federal government's claims that thousands of potentially ineligible people appear on the state's voter rolls. What are the allegations against the two Indian nationals?According to the DOJ, Shah, a resident of Sacramento, allegedly registered to vote on the day of the November 2024 US general election and cast a ballot that day. Kaur, a resident of Rancho Palos Verdes who is seeking US citizenship, allegedly registered to vote in December 2022 and cast a ballot in the November 2024 election. The department has said that the two are among the 28 green card holders charged in the case.  The charges include allegations involving false statements in naturalisation applications and fraudulent voter registration. The DOJ said the defendants appeared on a list of more than 20,000 people it had identified as likely non-citizen registrants and shared with California election officials. That list is part of a separate, broader dispute over voter eligibility and should not be interpreted as proof that every person identified committed an offence.  Can green card holders vote in US elections?No. A green card allows a foreign national to live and work permanently in the United States, but it does not confer US citizenship or the right to vote in federal elections. California's Secretary of State lists US citizenship as a basic requirement for voter registration. Applicants must also be California residents and meet the applicable age and other eligibility requirements. The state's registration process requires applicants to affirm their US citizenship.  Federal law also prohibits non-citizens from voting in elections held to choose the US president, vice-president and members of Congress. Under Section 611 of Title 18 of the US Code, unlawful voting by a non-citizen can carry a fine, imprisonment of up to one year, or both. Certain other election contests may be governed by separate state or local rules, but that does not permit non-citizens to vote for federal offices.  What penalties could the accused face?The DOJ said the charges in the California cases include making false statements in naturalisation applications and, in some cases, fraudulent voter registration. The department said the felony charges carry a maximum penalty of five years in federal prison. The precise charges and potential penalties depend on the allegations against each defendant.  The distinction between the charges matters. Allegedly voting unlawfully, registering fraudulently and making false statements in an application for citizenship are separate forms of conduct and may attract different penalties under different statutes. For people applying for naturalisation, an allegation involving a false statement can also raise questions about their eligibility for citizenship. However, the consequences for any individual will depend on the evidence, the charges ultimately pursued and the outcome of the legal proceedings. Why has California become the focus of the investigation?The arrests come just weeks before the November 3, 2026, US midterm elections, in which voters will choose members of Congress and decide a range of state and local contests. On October 15, the DOJ sued California, asking a federal court to prevent the state from counting mail-in ballots associated with more than 20,000 people whom federal authorities believe may be non-citizens, until their immigration status can be verified. The department said it identified the individuals by comparing publicly available voter-registration information with federal government databases. The dispute escalated after federal officials said California had not agreed to set aside the ballots while the eligibility of the individuals was checked. California conducts elections by mail and sends ballots to registered voters. The federal government is seeking court intervention to ensure that ballots it considers potentially ineligible are not counted.  The list of more than 20,000 people is, however, a list of individuals the federal government considers likely non-citizens. It is not a judicial finding that every person on the list registered unlawfully or voted illegally. What does California say?California officials have disputed the federal government's broader claims and defended the state's election safeguards. California Attorney General Rob Bonta said there was no widespread voter fraud in the state, while acknowledging that individual cases could occur. Secretary of State Shirley Weber has also criticised the federal government's attempts to obtain voter data and said the state's safeguards against non-citizen voting were robust.  There is also a concern about the accuracy of citizenship checks. Reuters reported that voting-rights advocates have warned that outdated federal immigration records could wrongly flag some naturalised US citizens as non-citizens. A person who has become a US citizen through naturalisation is eligible to register to vote if they meet the other requirements; an immigration database that has not been updated may not accurately reflect that person's current status.  An Associated Press report on the California arrests noted that non-citizen voting is considered rare and has not been shown to change election outcomes. Reuters reported on October 15 that its review of prosecutions under the federal law criminalising non-citizen voting had found 129 people prosecuted since the statute was enacted in 1996. Reuters also cited research indicating that instances of non-citizen voting are rare relative to the country's overall electorate.  The DOJ, meanwhile, has stepped up investigations and prosecutions. It said on October 19 that it had charged 28 people in California in the latest operation. AP reported that the department had charged 113 people across 20 states with illegal voting or registration offences over the preceding seven weeks. These figures describe enforcement activity, not the total number of people proven to have voted unlawfully.  What happens next?The 28 defendants will face criminal proceedings, where prosecutors will have to establish the allegations against each person. The DOJ's announcement said the 11 people arrested were expected to make initial appearances in federal courts on October 19, with no pleas to be taken at those appearances.  Separately, the federal lawsuit against California will determine whether the state can be compelled to set aside or verify ballots linked to the people identified by federal authorities. The outcome could affect the balance between federal election-enforcement efforts and states' responsibility for administering elections. For the two Indian nationals, the central issue is whether prosecutors can prove the specific allegations against them. Their status as green card holders does not itself constitute an offence; the allegations concern their reported registration and voting activity.

item.title: イタリア、ミラノに兵士500人を追加派遣 週末の暴動で対策強化
item.description:
Elisa Anzolin
[ミラノ １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Elisa Anzolin

[ミラノ １９日 ロイター] - イタリアのサルビーニ副首相は１９日、北部の都市ミラノでデモ参加者が警察と衝突し、店舗を略奪したり建物などを破壊する騒乱が２日間続いたことを受け、陸軍兵士５００人を派遣して「ミラノを守る」と表明した。

兵士の派遣は、２０日に開かれる閣議で承認される予定の治安対策パッケージに盛り込まれる見通し。

サルビーニ氏はソーシャルメディアに「言葉から行動へ。ミラノを守るため兵士５００人を追加派遣する」と投稿した。

ミラノ中心部の店舗は１９日、暴力行為の再発を懸念し、営業時間を切り上げ、窓を板などでふさいだ。シャネル、ティファニー、ディオールなどのブランドが店を構える高級ショッピング街、モンテナポレオーネ通りでは、大半の店舗が予防措置としてショーウインドーの商品を撤去。警察が通りを巡回し、少数の観光客がその様子を見守った。

ミラノでは先週末、公共サービスの質の低さや生活費の上昇に抗議する平和的なデモが騒乱に発展。顔にフードをかぶった数百人のデモ参加者が市中心部でごみ箱に放火し、店舗を略奪した。多くは未成年とみられる。

来年に総選挙を控えるメローニ首相は１９日、暴力行為を非難し、閣僚や治安当局幹部を集めて対応を協議した。日刊紙コリエレ・デラ・セラによると、メローニ氏は取り締まり強化策の一環として、未成年者に対する予防拘束の期間延長や、若者のギャング集団への取り締まり強化を検討している。議会で現在審議中の治安関連法案に盛り込まれた一部の規定について、施行を前倒しする案も浮上しているという。

イタリア警察によると、ミラノでは１８日の騒乱で若者２７１人の身柄を確保し、３２人を逮捕した。この中には未成年者２３人と外国籍の１３人が含まれていた。１７日にはミラノのほか、ボローニャ、ブレシア、ベルガモ、トリノなど北部の都市でも衝突が発生。当局によると２８人が逮捕された。

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝レイズがＷＳ進出、ブルワーズと激突へ 共に初優勝かけ
item.description: ［１９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１９日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）は１９日、ア・リーグ優勝決定シリーズ（７回戦制）の１試合を行い、レイズがガーディアンズを下して６年ぶり３回目のワールドシリーズ（ＷＳ）進出を決めた。

３勝２敗と王手をかけてこの日の第６戦を迎えたレイズは、二回にリッチー・パラシオス二塁手の２点適時二塁打で先制する。その後も追加点を重ねてリードを広げ、７─３の勝利でア・リーグ優勝を果たした。

１９９８年にデビルレイズとして発足したレイズは岩村明憲を擁した２００８年、そして２０年にワールドシリーズへ進出するも敗退。今季のナ・リーグを制したブルワーズもミルウォーキー移転で球団名を変更してから５７年目でいまだ優勝がなく、どちらが勝っても球団史上初のワールドシリーズ制覇となることが確定した。

ワールドシリーズは２３日からブルワーズの本拠地でスタートする。

item.title: トランプ氏「民主党勝てば米も炎上」、中間選挙集会で仏騒乱引き合い
item.description:
Bo Erickson Steve Holland
[パークシティー（米カンザス州） １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Bo Erickson　Steve Holland

[パークシティー（米カンザス州） １９日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１９日、中西部カンザス州で開いた共和党現職のロジャー・マーシャル上院議員の支援集会で、フランスでの大規模な抗議デモを引き合いに、２週間後に迫った中間選挙で民主党が勝てば米国でも同様の騒乱が起こり得ると主張した。

トランプ氏は「フランスで燃え上がる尖塔や猛火を目にしたら、それこそが過激派のまぬけな民主党が米国にやろうとしていることだ」と述べ、反移民・反イスラムの主張を展開した。根拠は示さなかった。

カンザス州は１９３２年以来、民主党から上院議員を選出していない保守州だが、マーシャル氏は民主党候補で牧師のアダム・ハミルトン氏と接戦になっている。ハミルトン氏はトランプ氏の関税政策や「不安定な指導力」を批判している。

１９日発表のロイター／イプソス世論調査では、トランプ氏の支持率は過去最低の３１％に低下。１１月３日の中間選挙に向け、イラン戦争や物価高への不満から共和党は保守州でも守勢を強いられている。会場近くのガソリン価格は昨年の州平均を約４５％上回っており、支持者からも経済への懸念が相次いだ。

item.title: Sea plans IPO for financial services arm Monee, memo says
item.description: Singapore-headquartered tech conglomerate Sea Limited is planning a public listing for its financial services arm Monee and will also launch an AI enterprise platform business, according to an internal memo sent on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Singapore-headquartered tech conglomerate Sea Limited (SE.N) is planning a public listing for its financial services arm Monee and will also launch an AI enterprise platform business, according to an internal memo sent on Tuesday. Founder Forrest Li, in a memo to employees that was reviewed by Reuters, said he believed going public would give its financial payments and services business the "resources and the room to go further and faster than it can today”. The business operates in Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, the Philippines, Taiwan, and Brazil and offers mobile wallets, payments processing, credit, and banking services. Sea did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The memo said the tech group would also launch an AI-first enterprise platform named Sea Cloud. In the memo, which was sent on the ninth anniversary of the group’s public listing in New York, Li said the quarterly revenue for the group had grown more than 80 times over that period to $7.8 billion. (This story has been corrected to change the spelling of the founder's name to 'Li,' not 'Lee,' in paragraphs 2 and 6.)

item.title: Software upgrades eat nearly a third of companies' IT budgets, survey finds
item.description: Large US and British companies spend 28% of their software budgets on average to pay for vendor-driven upgrades, migration and licensing changes they would not have actively chosen, adding avoidable costs and operational risks in the race to adopt AI solutions, a survey by software maintenance provider Origina showed on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Anastasiia Kozlova
item.content:encoded: Large US and British companies spend 28% of their software budgets on average to pay for vendor-driven upgrades, migration and licensing changes they would not have actively chosen, adding avoidable costs and operational risks in the race to adopt AI solutions, a survey by software maintenance provider Origina showed on Tuesday. These hard-to-avoid recurring costs and operational disruption were described as a "software tax" in the study that surveyed more than 2,000 companies. "When the alternative to an unwanted upgrade is losing support on systems the business runs on, saying yes is often a rational response," Origina CEO Tomas O'Leary said. 95% of respondents said they had paid for a vendor-driven upgrade they expected to worsen outcomes, while 80% said leaving a major software vendor would significantly disrupt their business 84% said senior engineering staff "always" or "often" devoted time to vendor-driven software changes rather than innovation or business-focused development 91% said they had retired fully functional hardware in the past three years to comply with vendors' support deadlines, sacrificing 1.65 years of remaining useful life on average O'Leary said the issue was largely universal and also applied to other regions, with older companies with more entrenched technology stacks facing the biggest challenges According to the report, the most recent vendor-driven software change resulted in an average annual cost of $12.87 million for the surveyed organizations (This story has been corrected to say 'vendor-driven,' not 'vendor-mandated,' in the second bullet point.)

item.title: Rubio kicks off India visit with trade deal, Russian oil on agenda
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio will travel to India on Tuesday, days after President Donald Trump delayed tariffs on US imports from the world's largest democracy as the two countries seek to finalize a trade deal.
item.dc:creator: Gram Slattery
item.content:encoded: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio will travel to India on Tuesday, days after President Donald Trump delayed tariffs on US imports from the world's largest democracy as the two countries seek to finalize a trade deal. During the two-day visit to Mumbai and Jamnagar in western India, Rubio is slated to meet government and business leaders, including Foreign Minister S. Jaishankar and billionaire Mukesh Ambani, chairman of Reliance Industries, which operates the world's largest refining complex at Jamnagar. Rubio and other officials have said in recent days that a comprehensive trade deal between the two nations is almost complete, raising the possibility that it could be signed during the secretary's visit. Trump removed one potential stumbling block last Friday when he waived potential tariffs that would have punished New Delhi for the nation's extensive Russian crude oil purchases. Under legislation signed by Trump in September, the administration is authorized to impose tariffs of up to 100% on the top five importers of Russian oil, which would include India, which is number two on that list after China. Trump's decision to waive all substantive provisions of that bill has upset both Democrats and Republicans who have pushed him to up economic pressure on Moscow for its war with Ukraine. Rubio has said in recent days that the effort to finalize a trade deal was a factor in the decision to waive those tariffs. He also said that India has been diversifying its import mix away from Russian crude, even as it still buys millions of barrels of Russian oil every day. He said the administration was entering a 60-day review period, during which it would consider which new tariffs, if any, to enact. "You've got countries like India, for example, that have voluntarily diversified their energy portfolio, but are still getting a substantial amount of energy from Russia because it's hard to pivot from one day to the next," Rubio said on Sunday. "But they're also an important ally and partner of the United States." While the Trump administration has in the past pressed India to cut Russian oil imports, the US signed a deal with Russia last week to import diesel to bring down domestic fuel prices before the midterm elections, making it unclear to what extent that remains a foreign policy priority. "Every country has a complex set of factors that they have to take into account," Rubio told reporters on Monday when asked about India's Russian oil purchases. "Geography is real. For some countries, it's very difficult to acquire energy from alternative sources." India imports more than 85% of its crude oil requirements to help power its fast-growing economy. Rubio is slated to fly into Mumbai from Samarkand, Uzbekistan, where he was meeting with Central Asian political and business leaders.

item.title: トランプ氏、ゼレンスキー大統領の交代を改めて要求 「事態の収拾に役立っていない」
item.description:
トランプ米大統領は10月19日、ウクライナ戦争の終結を目指す交渉について、ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領に代わる別の交渉担当者が必要との考えを改めて示した。ゼレンスキー氏は戦争を早期に終わらせなかったと指摘し、「私の助言を聞き入れていれば100万人の命が救われていたはずだ」と述べた。対ロ制裁解除をプーチン支援だと非難されたことに対しても反論した。
記者「ゼレンスキー氏は、あなたの立場は誤っていると批判しているが」 トランプ米大統領「ゼレンスキー氏がそう言ったのか。自分が何を言っているのか分かっていないのだ。 ゼレンスキー氏はこの戦争をはるか昔に終結させるべきだった。私の助言を聞いていればもっと良い合意が成立し、100万人の命が失われずに済んでいたはずだ。 正直に言って、ゼレンスキー氏はウクライナ側の交渉役として交代すべき時が来ている」
記者「ゼレンスキー氏は、あなたが制裁解除でロシアを支援していると非難している」
トランプ

記者「ゼレンスキー氏は、あなたの立場は誤っていると批判しているが」 トランプ米大統領「ゼレンスキー氏がそう言ったのか。自分が何を言っているのか分かっていないのだ。 ゼレンスキー氏はこの戦争をはるか昔に終結させるべきだった。私の助言を聞いていればもっと良い合意が成立し、100万人の命が失われずに済んでいたはずだ。 正直に言って、ゼレンスキー氏はウクライナ側の交渉役として交代すべき時が来ている」

記者「ゼレンスキー氏は、あなたが制裁解除でロシアを支援していると非難している」

トランプ氏「私が支援しているのはロシアとウクライナの停戦だ。いいか、それが私の本業だからだ。 率直に言ってゼレンスキー氏は事態の解決に寄与していない。彼は停戦を望んでいないと思う。 だが私は犠牲者を増やしたくない。毎月平均して2万5000人から3万5000人もの兵士が失われている。 私の望みはただ1つ、この戦争を止めることだけだ」

item.title: Korea’s KOSPI crashes another 5% as AI rout deepens; AI bellwether down over 40% from peak
item.description: Chip heavyweight SK Hynix Inc. headed for its lowest close since April. Data-center infrastructure company Elice Inc. plunged as much as 32% in its trading debut in Seoul. Both AI bellwethers SK Hynix and Samsung have plunged 35% and 22%, respectively.
item.dc:creator: Veer Sharma
item.content:encoded: South Korea’s benchmark KOSPI fell 5% on Tuesday as a chip-led sell-off in artificial intelligence stocks deepened, cutting its 2026 gains to about 30% from roughly 116% at its record close in June. The index has dipped over 40% from its peak of 9,386 earlier this year. Chip heavyweight SK Hynix Inc. headed for its lowest close since April. Data-center infrastructure company Elice Inc. plunged as much as 32% in its trading debut in Seoul. Both AI bellwethers SK Hynix and Samsung have plunged 35% and 22%, respectively. The index now trades about 39% below that peak. The decline gathered pace in July, when the KOSPI fell 22%, and extended into October, with the index losing another 17% through October 16.Read more: Global Market: Japan's Nikkei falls as higher yields, inflation fears weighWhat’s driving the sell-off?The latest leg of the decline follows a global sell-off in AI-linked stocks, which last week wiped out more than $1 trillion in market value from 20 of the world’s most valuable AI and semiconductor companies. South Korea has been particularly vulnerable to the rout because of its heavy exposure to memory chipmakers Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. The two companies accounted for 44% of the KOSPI in May. The sell-off gathered momentum as investors grew increasingly concerned about the credit risks associated with heavy AI spending. Further, stronger-than-expected US inflation data has added to the pressure, sending the index down 7.57% to 5,554.22.OpenAI’s revenue projections add to investor concernsQuestions over the sustainability of AI spending intensified after OpenAI told investors last week that its annualised revenue for September was nearly $50 billion, below the figure it had indicated earlier, Reuters reported.At a separate event, the company had previously told investors that its September revenue run rate was approaching $70 billion. The discrepancy largely stemmed from an effort to make a direct comparison with revenue figures from rival Anthropic, according to the Reuters report.The figures have added to investor scrutiny of the financial assumptions underpinning the AI rally, particularly as companies continue to commit substantial sums to infrastructure and computing capacity.AI’s next hurdle may be the cost of capitalConcerns about financing are also coming from within the semiconductor industry. Earlier this week, Broadcom CEO Hock Tan said capital could become a bigger constraint on AI expansion than shortages of semiconductors, memory chips or electricity.Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan echoed the concern, pointing to rising capital costs and the need for companies making heavy AI investments to demonstrate adequate returns.The warnings come as investors reassess whether the pace of AI investment can be sustained amid stretched valuations, intensifying competition and uncertainty over when the spending will translate into profits.What lies ahead for AI stocks?The debate over AI valuations is also prompting calls for investors to diversify beyond the sector. In his latest GREED & fear note, Jefferies’ Global Head of Equity Strategy Chris Wood highlighted a warning from the firm’s global quantitative strategy team that “it has become time to diversify beyond AI.”The report projects earnings growth for global AI stocks to slow from nearly 100% in 2026 to 30% in 2027 and 22% in 2028. By comparison, earnings growth for global stocks excluding AI is expected to decline from 16% this year to 9% in both 2027 and 2028.Valuations further underline the divide. Global AI stocks trade at about 23 times forward earnings on an equal-weighted basis, compared with 13 times for the global ex-AI basket, according to the report.Wood has pointed to rising borrowing costs as a central factor in the AI spending boom, raising questions about how long the market will continue to finance the trade.With earnings growth expected to moderate and AI stocks trading at a substantial premium to the broader market, the sustainability of the rally increasingly hinges on companies delivering returns on their investments, alongside the availability and cost of financing.Disclaimer: This article has been written by Veer Sharma, who is not a SEBI-registered Research Analyst or an Investment Adviser. item.title: How safe havens stack up as tech, energy and France fears grip markets
item.description: Demand for safe-haven assets is strong as AI jitters hurt tech stocks, the Iran war continues and keeps energy prices elevated, while worries about high government debt loads persist.
item.dc:creator: Sophie Kiderlin, Canan Sevgili, Sruthi Shankar
item.content:encoded: Demand for safe-haven assets is strong as [USN:L6N461185 TEXT:"AI jitters"] hurt tech stocks, the Iran war continues and keeps energy prices elevated, while worries about high government debt loads persist. Yet traditional safe havens have not performed as well as expected this year: Gold sold off after the start of the Iran war as investors ditched [USN:L4N3ZR1OA TEXT:"top-performing assets"] given losses elsewhere. Government bonds, once considered one of the world's safest assets, [USN:L1N462089 TEXT:"are volatile"]. Here is a look at how some safe havens currently stack up. 1) LOVE/HATE RELATIONSHIP WITH THE DOLLAR Breaking with last year's [USN:L1N3YR0W1 TEXT:"'sell US' theme"], the dollar has rallied since the Iran war started, up 4% since late February. That has reinforced its role as a go-to safe haven at times of global stress. A strong economy, higher rates, and the US's energy-exporter status have helped. But factors that caused traders to question the dollar's long-term safe-haven status, such as a more than [USN:L6N44O018 TEXT:"$40 trillion"] debt pile and policy uncertainty, have not dissipated. The dollar is also vulnerable to tech selling as it has benefited from record capital inflows into US shares on optimism over the AI investment boom. The dollar could be nearing the back end of a bull market, Societe Generale chief FX strategist Kit Juckes said. "It hasn't got that much further to go," he noted, but said it was hard to justify a sustained bet against the dollar at present because the "big global story is that the dollar is a petrocurrency and we're in the middle of an energy crisis". 2) EUROPE WOBBLES, BUY SWISSIE One takeaway from [USN:L1N462089 TEXT:"France-driven bond turmoil"] is that the Swiss franc is a haven of choice when Europe wobbles. It is up over 2% so far this month against the euro , poised for its biggest monthly jump since late 2023. "Concerns about France's public finances and election uncertainty in France and [USN:L8N46305T TEXT:"Spain"] have supported the franc," said Georgette Boele, senior FX & oil strategist at ABN Amro. She added that investors were also becoming less keen to use the franc to fund [USN:L4N44813J TEXT:"carry trades"], preferring not to position against a currency with safe-haven qualities. [USN:L8N45U0H9 TEXT:"Swiss rates at 0%"] make the franc popular in trades where investors borrow in a currency with low rates to invest in higher-yielding assets elsewhere. The AI jitters should also benefit the Swiss franc, analysts said. 3) GERMAN BONDS A RELATIVE WINNER Government bonds' reputation as a safe haven has been battered by fiscal concerns. [USN:L1N45N0S4 TEXT:"Borrowing costs"] from the US to Japan recently hit multi-decade highs. The tech-driven stocks selloff has, however, renewed some demand for bonds. There is another noticeable development. When US and French 10-year bond yields hit 24-year peaks earlier this month, German yields fell as their prices rose. Investors say that is a clear sign that triple-A rated German Bunds stand out as safe havens among major economies. Bundesbank President Joachim Nagel said Germany would remain the [USN:L1N462040 TEXT:"anchor of stability"] in Europe amid bond turmoil and was "getting fit" after years of stagnation. "Everyone worries about contagion in Europe and whether the Bund just gets dragged along with (French) OATs, (Italian) BTPs, so it's good that the Bund has acted as that European risk-off instrument," said Johnathan Owen, a portfolio manager at TwentyFour Asset Management. 4) DID YOU FORGET SHORT-DATED BONDS? Overall, high debt among major economies will continue to hurt long-dated bonds' safe-haven status, investors said. But short-dated government bonds provide some shelter because they are less sensitive to debt worries. "We really like short-dated bonds," said Rory McPherson, chief market strategist at Wren Sterling. "Because of all the concerns over debts and deficits, we haven't been buying longer-dated bonds." 5) GOLD KEEPS ITS SPARKLE Gold, another traditional safe haven, has had a bumpy ride. After hitting record highs at $5,595 per troy ounce in January, it fell after the Iran war started as investors tapped the precious metal, given losses elsewhere. Gold rallied again in August as inflation fears and concern that the Federal Reserve was not doing enough to contain price pressures returned. It is trading around $4,175. Central bank buying and [USN:L8N45M19N TEXT:"safe-haven demand"] support prices above $4,000, analysts say. While high interest rates should limit gold's upside, a tense geopolitical backdrop and US fiscal worries should bolster the safe-haven metal further out. "In the longer term, gold should again benefit from continued strong central-bank buying and renewed concerns over US debt and its rising interest burden," said Julius Baer analyst Carsten Menke.

item.title: China adds extra Havana flight as Cuba fuel crisis strands travellers
item.description: China organised a flight out of Cuba's capital Havana, its embassy in Cuba said, after frequent changes and cancellations to scheduled flights left passengers stranded.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China organised a flight out of Cuba's capital Havana, its embassy in Cuba said, after frequent changes and cancellations to scheduled flights left passengers stranded. Airlines have been suspending flights due to refuelling issues amid a deepening Cuban oil crisis triggered by US sanctions. China arranged a "replacement" flight for Air China (601111.SS) CA866, a service from Havana to Beijing, the Chinese embassy in Cuba said in a statement on Monday. The statement said CA866's schedule had changed frequently recently due to "technical reasons" and some flights had been cancelled. It did not refer to Cuba's oil crisis. Replacement flight CA590 left Havana on Monday night and landed in Nassau, Bahamas at 11:25 p.m. on October 19 (0325 GMT on October 20), according to records from the website FlightAware. The flight will continue to Madrid before arriving in Beijing, FlightAware showed. The US has [USN:L6N466032 TEXT:"piled pressure"] on Cuba's government, including a nine-month de facto fuel blockade and reinforced sanctions that have led to an unprecedented economic crisis on the island. China's foreign ministry referred to other government departments in response to Reuters questions. China's aviation regulator and Air China did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

item.title: Declared dead: Indian voters fight to get back on electoral rolls
item.description: Kamta Prasad has been shuttling between government offices in Delhi trying to prove he is not dead.
item.dc:creator: Saurabh Sharma
item.content:encoded: Kamta Prasad has been shuttling between government offices in Delhi trying to prove he is not dead. The 53-year-old tailor is among 130 million names removed from India's electoral rolls under a voter roll revision that has sparked mass protests and posed the biggest challenge to Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government. The [USN:L4N45Z0IJ TEXT:"Special Intensive Revision"] (SIR) has led to removals for reasons ranging from "logical discrepancies" to people being recorded as dead, leaving many such as Prasad struggling to get more than just their voting status restored. He has had to forgo his daily wage of 250 rupees ($2.63) that supports his family of four to scurry around the city to reverse the error. "I panicked when I heard about it," said Prasad, who is among 4.2 million Delhi voters struck off the list, according to the draft rolls published by the poll body on August 31. "Since then I've been going everywhere to prove that I'm alive." The deletions have triggered a [USN:L6N46206J TEXT:"political storm"], with opposition parties and youth groups staging near-daily protests in New Delhi and elsewhere, which have been met with force by the police. They allege Election Commission chief [USN:L4N45K0DB TEXT:"Gyanesh Kumar"] manipulated the revision to benefit Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party, a charge denied by both the commission and the BJP. 'NOBODY LISTENS' According to Rajendra Kumar, a volunteer with non-profit Jan Sarokar, about 2,000 of the roughly 9,000 voters in Prasad's block were struck off after the revision, classified as absent, shifted, deceased or registered elsewhere. Prasad is the only person in this block who has been declared dead but several similar cases have been reported by local media across the country. The Election Commission has said it was removing duplicate, deceased, shifted and otherwise ineligible voters and that anyone excluded in error can file claims, submit supporting documents and pursue appeals before the rolls are finalised. For voters such as Prasad, however, exclusion leads to a bureaucratic maze, and depending on the circumstances they may have to provide proof of life, establish residency, correct alleged discrepancies or submit fresh documentation. That involves repeated visits to election offices, hearings before electoral officials and multiple rounds of appeals, with some spending weeks or months trying to restore their names. "I told them I voted in the last assembly and general elections and have been voting for 35 years, but nobody listens," Prasad said. India's Election Commission did not reply to a request for comment for this story. REGISTER AS A NEW VOTER Following weeks of protests, the Election Commission ordered fresh verification in some states, including Delhi, and Prasad said officials had assured him his name would be restored. Kamal Lal, a 38-year-old private school teacher in Delhi, was marked as "shifted" even though he still lives in a settlement beneath a flyover with dozens of other families. "It is very disappointing that we have been voting in this country and now our names have been cut because we do not have land papers or a water bill," he said. Lal said he first learned of his exclusion in September and has since approached election officials, attended hearings and filed multiple reinstatement applications. For some excluded voters, the remedy offered by officials has brought little comfort: rather than restoring their previous registrations, they were advised to apply afresh as new voters. For poorer voters, fears run even deeper. "Now local election officials are asking us to register as new voters, and my husband is strongly opposed to that because he has voted in the last few elections," said 39-year-old Mamta, who does not use a surname. "I am worried that if our names are not restored to the list, I could lose access to subsidised ration and other government welfare schemes."

item.title: Cowboys give coach Brian Schottenheimer vote of confidence
item.description: The Dallas Cowboys stumbled to their fourth loss in six games this season on Sunday, but coach Brian Schottenheimer doesn't have to fear for his job, according to team executive vice president Stephen Jones.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Dallas Cowboys stumbled to their fourth loss in six games this season on Sunday, but coach Brian Schottenheimer doesn't have to fear for his job, according to team executive vice president Stephen Jones. Speaking Monday on 105.3 The Fan in Dallas, Jones was asked whether he and his father, club owner Jerry Jones, retained their faith in Schottenheimer. "Absolutely. There's not any question in Jerry's and (my) mind," Stephen Jones said. "He has the team. There's no question they want to go out there and execute and make things happen. We feel really good ... about our coaching staff. We just have to continue to evolve and get to a point where we can win these football games." Schottenheimer is in his second season with the Cowboys, who went 7-9-1 and missed the playoffs last year. Dallas' latest game was a 23-13 road loss to the Green Bay Packers on Sunday night. The Cowboys trailed 17-0 at halftime, having gained just 107 total yards. The second half was slightly more competitive, but Dallas never cut the margin below 10 points. Schottenheimer said Monday, "I think at the end of the day, I'm focused on the process of turning this around for myself, the players. Certainly not good enough. We're disappointed with where we're at. We know we need to play better. We know we can play better. And I think at the end of the day, we've got the right guys to do that." Dallas will be on the road again next Monday to oppose the Philadelphia Eagles, who just learned that quarterback Jalen Hurts is out for the season due to blood clots in his lungs. The Cowboys rank 13th in the NFL in total offense (343.2 yards per game) and 11th in scoring offense (25.2 points per game) but 30th in total defense (382.5 ypg) and 25th in scoring defense (26.5 ppg). "We're going to get back to work and we'll figure it out," Schottenheimer said. "We have great trust in our offense. I'm not concerned about our offense. ... We own that. It is what it is. It's not been good enough, but we also have a history of being really explosive, really good. And we've done that not only last year, but in four of our games this year." --Field Level Media

item.title: Australian govt to sue Facebook, TikTok for alleged breaches of ban
item.description: The country's online safety regulator, eSafety Commissioner, said in March it was investigating Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat and YouTube for potentially failing to adhere to the law ...
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: By Angus Whitley Australia’s government is set to sue Facebook, TikTok and other major digital platforms for alleged non-compliance with a nationwide social media ban for under-16s, Communications Minister Anika Wells said in an interview. The country’s online safety regulator, eSafety Commissioner, said in March it was investigating Facebook and Instagram — both owned by Meta Platforms Inc. — TikTok, Snapchat and YouTube for potentially failing to adhere to the law. The legislation requires the companies to take reasonable steps to stop underage users from holding social media accounts, part of a bid to protect them from harmful online content. In an interview in Sydney on Monday, Wells said she expected legal action to proceed against the five platforms. An eSafety report in July found most underage social media users were able to keep their accounts or create new ones, largely due to a lack of effective age checks on the platforms. Since Australia’s world-first ban came into force almost a year ago, the government has doubled the maximum penalty for breaches to A$109.2 million ($76 million). The government also granted eSafety Commissioner Julie Inman Grant greater investigative powers, including the ability to demand documents from social media platforms and summon current or ex-employees to answer questions. “Now she has more powers to be able to gather the evidence that she needs to take those five companies to the Federal Court,” Wells said. “She’s now using those powers to prepare her case.” Spokespersons for Meta and eSafety had no immediate comments. Representatives for Snapchat owner Snap Inc., TikTok and its owner ByteDance Ltd., and YouTube parent Google didn’t immediately reply to emails seeking responses to the minister’s comments. The eSafety Commissioner is an independent regulator, though part of the government and accountable to Australia’s parliament through the communications minister, a position currently held by Wells. Last week Wells said companies aren’t doing enough to adhere to social media age restrictions. “The law is not failing — platforms are failing to comply with the law,” Wells said in an Oct. 15 speech to the National Press Club. “We won’t flinch at holding tech companies to account.”

item.title: Indonesia to deploy more than 9,000 security officers at protests marking Prabowo's two years in power
item.description: More than 9,000 Indonesian police officers will be deployed in the capital Jakarta on Tuesday to handle protests marking President Prabowo Subianto's two years in office, authorities said, after polls showed his popularity was on the wane.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: More than 9,000 Indonesian police officers will be deployed in the capital Jakarta on Tuesday to handle protests marking President Prabowo Subianto's two years in office, authorities said, after polls showed his popularity was on the wane. Students from at least two universities will stage protests in several spots in Jakarta, city police spokesperson Budi Hermanto told reporters on Tuesday, requiring the deployment of around 9,500 officers The student body of the University of Indonesia said on Tuesday that it would protest against recent [USN:L6N4610Y7 TEXT:"forest fires"] as well as the [USN:L4N46509U TEXT:"rout"] on the stock market, which along with the the weakening rupiah was a signal of the "national economy's fragility" It is unclear how many students will be involved in the demonstrations Environment group Greenpeace draped a banner on a major Jakarta monument on Tuesday that read "deal with the climate crisis, lower cost of living" Prabowo was [USN:L1N3LU08I TEXT:"sworn in"] as president on October 20, 2024 The retired general won the election with a huge majority but he is battling to restore the confidence of the public, business and investors, who have been worried by the economic impact of his ambitious, populist [USN:L1N4530A5 TEXT:"programmes"] His approval rating in surveys by Saiful Mujani Research and Consulting (SMRC) has fallen steadily since late last year His approval rating reached its lowest level of 44.5% [USN:L4N4620I7 TEXT:"this month"], falling from 81.2% in November last year Indonesia's last major protest took place in August, when [USN:L1N44P0CI TEXT:"hundreds"] were detained Nationwide protests broke out in Indonesia after the police killing of a motorcycle taxi driver in [USN:L6N3UO0KC TEXT:"2025"], with several people killed during the unrest

item.content:encoded: ケニアの裁判所は19日、断食カルトの指導者ポール・マッケンジー被告とほか28人に対し、児童190人と成人1人を死亡させた殺人罪で有罪の判決を下した。近年、世界で起きたカルト教団関連の事件でも最悪規模の惨事の一つとなった。 検察によると、マッケンジー被告と同被告率いるグッドニュース・インターナショナル教会は、キリスト教の終末論を唱える宗派を組織。世界が終わる前に天国に行くため、信者自身とその子どもが死に至るまで絶食するよう命じていたという。 集団埋葬地の発見以来、この事件はケニアで大きな関心を集めてきた。 警察が2017年に施設を捜索するなど、当局が動向を把握していたにもかかわらず、なぜマッケンジー被告が活動を続けられたのかという疑問も浮上した。警察によると、2019年に当局はマッケンジー被告の教会を閉鎖させたが、同被告はシャカホラの森へ移って活動を続けていた。 マッケンジー被告は犠牲者に絶食を強制していないとして殺人罪を否認したが、裁判所はこの主張を退けた。 同被告らに対する量刑は11月6日に言い渡される。弁護人は控訴する意向を示した。 シャカホラの森では、これまでに計400体以上の遺体が見つかっている。 子どもの遺体の多くは腐敗が激しく、身元を確認できたのは26人にとどまった。他の死者については捜査が続いている。

item.title: 49ers stave off Commanders' comeback bid, remain unbeaten
item.description: Brock Purdy threw for 264 yards and a touchdown, Christian McCaffrey rushed for two scores, and the San Francisco 49ers remained unbeaten with a 23-17 win over the Washington Commanders on Monday night in Santa Clara, Calif.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Brock Purdy threw for 264 yards and a touchdown, Christian McCaffrey rushed for two scores, and the San Francisco 49ers remained unbeaten with a 23-17 win over the Washington Commanders on Monday night in Santa Clara, Calif. The 49ers withstood a second-half rally by Washington and moved to 6-0 for the first time since 2019, when they opened with eight straight wins in a season when they reached the Super Bowl. Purdy completed 21 of 29 passes and recorded his 36th win in 56 regular-season starts. McCaffrey had 16 carries for 64 yards and nine receptions for 53 yards. San Francisco led 23-3 late in the third quarter before Washington scored 14 unanswered points. The Commanders trailed 23-17 and reached the 49ers' 17-yard line with two minutes remaining before Malik Mustafa broke up a fourth-down pass to Treylon Burks at the goal line. After forcing the 49ers to punt, Washington got the ball back at its own 46-yard line with 52 seconds left. The Commanders reached San Francisco's 28-yard line, but Jayden Daniels was sacked by Romello Height and Keion White on the game's final play. Daniels finished 29 of 40 for 300 yards with two touchdown passes for the Commanders (1-4-1), who are winless in their past three games (0-2-1). San Francisco led 20-3 at halftime after piling up a 303-90 advantage in total yards. Purdy capped the 49ers' opening drive with an 11-yard touchdown pass to George Kittle. Washington answered with Drew Stevens' 51-yard field goal before Purdy began the 49ers' next drive with a 54-yard completion to Mike Evans. After McCaffrey capped the eight-play drive with a 1-yard touchdown run, Eddy Pineiro missed the extra-point attempt. Commanders wide receiver Terry McLaurin was carted off the field late in the first quarter due to a knee injury. Evans, who was listed as questionable to play, had three receptions for 94 yards before exiting just prior to halftime after aggravating his Achilles injury. San Francisco added to its lead with 13 seconds left in the half when McCaffrey capped a 14-play drive with a 1-yard touchdown run. After the 49ers moved ahead 23-3 on Pineiro's 33-yard field goal with 5:56 to go in the third quarter, Washington cut into the deficit on Daniels' 1-yard touchdown pass to Stefon Diggs late in the period. The Commanders pulled within 23-17 with 9:22 left in the fourth quarter when Daniels connected with Rachaad White on a 9-yard touchdown pass. --Field Level Media

item.title: 韓国、北朝鮮に「断固たる処罰」警告 境界での軍備増強示唆受け
item.description:
Kyu-seok Shim
[ソウル ２０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Kyu-seok Shim

[ソウル ２０日 ロイター] - 韓国は２０日、北朝鮮が予告している軍事境界線（ＭＤＬ）沿いでの軍備増強を実行すれば、厳しく対応すると表明した。

北朝鮮の金正恩朝鮮労働党総書記の妹である金与正党総務部長は１９日、同国が韓国との境界線付近への戦術兵器の追加配備や拡声器による放送の再開を検討していると述べた。

これを受け、朝鮮半島の緊張が高まっている。

韓国国防省は声明で、北朝鮮の警告に深刻な懸念を表明した。

同省は、ＭＤＬ付近で韓国軍が行っている放送や警告射撃は、越境を防ぎ、境界線を越えた北朝鮮兵を撤退させるための「正当な防衛措置」だと説明。「北朝鮮がわれわれの正当な措置を口実にさらなる挑発を行えば、断固として処罰する」と表明した。

また、北朝鮮に対し、根拠のない主張やＭＤＬを越える行為をやめ、境界線を巡る双方の認識の違いを解消する取り組みに応じるよう求めた。

韓国軍は別の声明で、陳永承合同参謀本部議長が最前線の陸軍司令部を訪れて即応態勢を点検し、非武装地帯（ＤＭＺ）で韓国側の主導権を強化するための作戦を指示したと明らかにした。

陳氏は「北朝鮮がわれわれの正当な作戦上の措置を挑発だと偽って位置付け、軍事的緊張が高まった責任をわが軍に転嫁することは容認できない」と述べた。

また、９月にＭＤＬの南側で韓国兵が地雷により重傷を負った事件について、地雷を設置した責任は北朝鮮にあると指摘。「明白な挑発」であり、休戦協定違反だと語った。

item.title: Indonesian markets inch up after authorities move to stem rout on MSCI expulsion fears
item.description: Indonesian stocks rose on Tuesday as authorities in Jakarta introduced measures to restrict selling after a record two-day $82 billion rout sparked by index provider MSCI's warning of possible removal from its global indexes.
item.dc:creator: Ankur Banerjee, Stefanno Sulaiman
item.content:encoded: Indonesian stocks rose on Tuesday as authorities in Jakarta introduced measures to restrict selling after a [USN:L1N46500W TEXT:"record two-day"] $82 billion rout sparked by index provider MSCI's [USN:L4N46509U TEXT:"warning"] of possible removal from its global indexes. Jakarta's benchmark index (.JKSE) rose 3% on Tuesday, after hitting a six-year low in the previous session as the world's worst-performing stock market this year dropped 14.8% over Friday and Monday. MSCI on Friday said it was [USN:L4N46124S TEXT:"considering"] shifting Indonesia to "[USN:L6N46208E TEXT:"standalone"]" instead of "emerging markets" status, a more-severe-than-expected downgrade that shocked investors and officials. To slow the heavy selloff on the market, which is down about 40% this year, the stock exchange this week halved the daily down limit on stock prices to 7% from 15%, while setting a 1 rupiah down limit on shares priced at 14 rupiah or less. The move from the index provider has weighed on the rupiah as well, which strengthened slightly to 18,010 per US dollar on Tuesday but remained close to the record low of 18,190 hit in June. Jakarta authorities met with the index provider on Monday to seek an explanation about its latest warning, which stemmed from concerns that Indonesia had yet to improve ownership transparency or clamp down on coordinated trading. Also on Monday, Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto held talks with finance chiefs, including the head of the Financial Services Authority (OJK), the finance minister and the central bank governor. OJK chief Friderica Widyasari Dewi said the regulator would continue to advance Indonesia's capital market reforms, particularly regarding transparency, liquidity, and law enforcement against various forms of violations. "A particularly important special message is how we must continuously enforce regulations against those who have committed violations related to coordinated trading and other similar practices," Friderica said after the meeting. The regulator on Friday unveiled sanctions against those linked to alleged trading manipulation in shares of three firms, with the fines totalling 2.1 trillion rupiah. In another step to address MSCI's concerns, the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) on Monday said it would exclude from its benchmark index any stocks with a high concentration of ownership by the same person or entity. "We will continue to carry out initiatives aimed at fostering greater transparency, a more credible market, and better governance," IDX President Director Jeffrey Hendrik said following the meeting with MSCI. George Xu, a director in Fitch Ratings' sovereigns team, said the latest concerns and substantial market selloff reinforced the risks the rating agency identified when it [USN:L1N3ZS06T TEXT:"revised the outlook"] on Indonesia to negative in March. "From sovereign rating perspective, we do not anticipate the consultation announcement itself to have material immediate credit implications," he said, but said external pressure could raise the government’s borrowing costs and erode external buffers.

item.title: China's off-kilter tech economy is by design
item.description: Tech exports powered 4.5% quarterly GDP growth, keeping Beijing on track to hit its annual target. Policymakers are in no rush to dig deep to tackle a property slump and weak domestic demand. Indeed, continued financial support to AI, robotics and green energy will widen divide.
item.dc:creator: Ka Sing Chan
item.content:encoded: Beijing is embracing its lopsided tech economy. Exports powered third-quarter GDP growth to 4.5% despite weak domestic demand and a slumping property sector, keeping the country on track to hit its annual 4.5% to 5% target. Economic planners are in no rush to dig deep to tackle the imbalances. Indeed, China's mobilisation of financial and policy support to artificial intelligence, robotics and other high-tech sectors will continue to widen the divide. On paper, the world's second-largest economy is going from strength to strength. Exports surged 22% in the third quarter compared to a year ago, led by a 70% jump in electronic components. Output of industrial robots and 3D-printing equipment rose 29.1% and 62.5%, respectively, in the first nine months. All in all, high-tech manufacturing and tech contributed to over 40% of GDP growth, per the National Bureau of Statistics, offsetting weakness across the $20 trillion economy. Real estate investment, the traditional backbone of China's growth model and consumer confidence, plummeted 21% year-on-year in the first nine months of the year. That's one factor behind sluggish retail sales, which grew just 1.1% despite repeated government pledges to boost demand. That is, in some ways, a vindication of President Xi Jinping's economic vision. Articulated in 2023, he identified industries including electric vehicles, AI, batteries, renewable energy and more as the country's [USN:L3N3FJ023 TEXT:""new productive forces" "]designed to replace the speculative and debt-driven property sector as the primary growth engine. Indeed, the International Monetary Fund estimates annual state support into favoured sectors, mainly in the form of cash subsidies, tax breaks and low-cost credit, totalled 4.4% of GDP as of 2023 - implying over $800 billion. That contrasts with efforts to revive consumption and housing. Beijing's consumer trade-in programme will cost about 250 billion yuan ($37 billion) this year, while its new mortgage subsidy scheme is expected to require only around 18 billion yuan a year. The trade off is that while these new growth drivers have propelled exports and capital spending, they have failed to create sufficient jobs or boost incomes to revive consumption. On this, resource-constrained policymakers have opted to take a slower and measured approach, such as dedicated five-year plans to help small and medium enterprises, as well as multi-year efforts to bolster social safety nets. It's a feature Beijing has accepted in its tech-powered economy. China’s gross domestic product expanded 4.5% in the July-September quarter compared with the same period last year, the National Bureau of Statistics said on October 19. The government has set an annual growth target of between 4.5% and 5%. CONTEXT-NEWS
