item.title: Chinese official says economy resilient but recovery momentum remains weak
item.description: China's economy has withstood pressure and continues to expand steadily, but the recovery foundation and momentum are relatively weak, an economic official at the National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) told a press conference on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China's economy has withstood pressure and continues to expand steadily, but the recovery foundation and momentum are relatively weak, an economic official at the National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) told a press conference on Tuesday. The comments were made following the [USN:L1N46501H TEXT:"release"] of better-than-expected economic growth data for the third quarter on Monday, as roaring exports offset consumers' tight grip on their wallets. The impact of external shocks is deepening, while a mismatch between strong supply and weak demand at home remains pronounced, said Zuo Gang, deputy director for the Department of National Economic Comprehensive Affairs at the NDRC, which is the country's top economic planner. Divergence across industries is also evident, and the foundation and the momentum for a sustained economic recovery remain weak, he added. The NDRC is drafting an implementation plan for the strategy to expand domestic demand for 2026-2030 and will accelerate efforts to issue and implement it, Zuo said.

item.title: 午前のドル158円半ば、レンジ上限で動けず 円の弱さ指摘も
item.description:
Atsuko Aoyama
[東京 ２０日 ロイター] - 午前のドルは１５８円半ばでの膠着が続いた。直近のレンジ上限...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
午前のドル158円半ば、レンジ上限で動けず　円の弱さ指摘も 12:28 配信

米ドル紙幣。26年3月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Atsuko Aoyama

[東京 ２０日 ロイター] - 午前のドルは１５８円半ばでの膠着が続いた。直近のレンジ上限に当たり、上抜けるにも押し下げるにも材料に乏しいとの声がある。上値では日米の協調為替介入への警戒でドル買い／円売りに追随する動きは強まっていないが、他資産に比べた円の弱さが改めて意識されているとの見方も聞かれた。

・ドル／円、午前中は１５８円半ばで膠着

・直近のレンジの上限、２００日移動平均線近辺で上値重い

・来週以降のイベント待ちで動けずとの声も

・前日のドル／円はレンジ上抜け試す動き、円の弱さ浮き彫りとの声

・一部に高市早苗首相の財源巡るⅩ投稿を円売り材料視する向きも

・ドル１５９円台では円安けん制など口先介入に警戒

＜トレイダーズ証券の井口喜雄・市場部長＞

「ドル／円は直近のレンジ上限で２００日移動平均線近辺にあるが、ブレイクするようなイベントがない。じりじりとして動きが少なく、例えばレンジ上限で売るという判断も躊躇するところ」

「米国のＩＴ株が振るわない中でドルを買う理由にも乏しい。一方、市場が深刻なリスクオフとなった場合は円キャリーが剥がれてドル安／円高が進むかもれないが、今のような株の調整程度なら動意づくこともない」

「円買い理由があるとすれば日銀の利上げ加速だが、それが見えない。来年３－４月までの米国の利上げ観測を踏まえると金利差は一向に縮まらず、ドル／円を下目線ではみられない」

item.title: アングル：期待と誤算に揺れた日中の1年 高市政権下の改善「難しい」と関係者
item.description:
Tamiyuki Kihara
[東京 ２０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Tamiyuki Kihara

[東京 ２０日 ロイター] - 高市早苗首相の就任から２１日で１年になる。「世界の真ん中で咲き誇る日本外交」を掲げる一方、経済・地政学の両面で関わりの深い中国との関係は厳しい冷え込みが続く。一時は関係改善に意欲的だった政府関係者らは、ロイターの取材に「高市政権のうちは難しい」と口をそろえた。

＜選挙勝利に懸けた期待＞

「強い政権ができれば中国は対話を求めてくるはずだ」。日本の外務省関係者がこう自信をのぞかせて話したのは今年１月、高市氏が電撃的な衆院解散を決めた直後だった。選挙に勝利して長期政権の足掛かりをつかめば、中国としても高市政権と向き合わざるを得なくなる。ハイレベルの対話が生まれ、関係は改善に向かう。こう考えたのだ。

その約２カ月半前の昨年１１月、高市氏が国会で台湾有事も日本の存立危機事態になり得ると述べ、両国関係は一気に冷え込んだ。中国は今年１月、軍民両用（デュアルユース）品の対日輸出規制強化を発表。レアアース（希土類）が対象に含まれるとの見方が広がり、政府内からは「中国は本気で日本国内の分断を図っている」との声が上がった。輸出規制で被害を受ける企業や物価高で苦しむ国民が高市氏から離れれば、いくら人気のある政権でも持ちこたえられないかもしれない。そんな意図と受け止めた。

実際、前出の関係者は高市氏の台湾有事発言以降、中国との対話の糸口をつかめずにいた。だからこそ、選挙で高市氏が勝利を収めれば「中国は分断戦略の見直しを余儀なくされる。両国のムードが変わるはずだ」と期待してもいた。

２月８日投開票の衆院選で、自民党は３１６議席を獲得する圧勝。単独で衆院の３分の２を超えた。

＜誤算となった「勝ち過ぎ」＞

しかし、日中のムードは変わらなかった。公式なハイレベル対話は実現せず、日本外務省がホームページで公開する中国との「要人往来・会談」の欄は、国際会議に合わせ訪中した政務三役の活動報告などの記載にとどまる。

なぜ選挙で勝っても中国との関係改善が進まないのか。複数の日本政府関係者によると、日本政府は選挙後、中国側との対話を引き続き模索しているものの、一時期に比べればその熱量は決して高くないという。

前出の外務省関係者はその要因に、「選挙で勝ち過ぎたこと」を挙げた。台湾有事発言を撤回しない高市氏の「対中強硬路線」が、選挙での勝利によって信認を得てしまったという見方だ。これまでは、日中関係が悪化すれば経済に影響が及ぶため、関係はマネージしなければならないというのが日本政府内の共通認識だった。それが高市政権で崩れかけているとし、同関係者は「日中関係を壊したままでいいという世論が大勢となったとき、日本は将来どうなってしまうのか想像もつかない」とも語った。

＜焦点は１１月のＡＰＥＣ＞

１１月には中国・深圳でアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）が開かれる。昨年の同会議では、高市氏と中国の習近平国家主席との会談が実現した。政府内では高市氏の台湾有事発言後、「次のＡＰＥＣに向けて対中戦略を練る」との声も出ていた。

９月にワシントンで開かれた米中首脳会談では、トランプ米大統領が習氏に、日本と対話するよう促したことが分かっている。ただ、現時点で日中首脳会談の見通しは立っていない。政府内で頼みの綱とみられてきた米国による働きかけが空振りに終われば、日中関係改善への期待はついえる恐れがある。

トランプ氏は１０月１９日、ＡＰＥＣに合わせた米中ロ首脳による３者会談開催について、記者団に「核兵器と非核化について話し合うために会談が行われる可能性がある」とし、「習主席が開催を望むなら応じる。貿易など他の問題についても話し合うことになるだろう」と語った。

＜高市外交左右する対中戦略＞

こうした現状について、キヤノングローバル戦略研究所（ＣＩＧＳ）上席研究員兼中国研究センター長の峯村健司氏は、「高市首相は中国に対して『対話の扉は開いている』と言うが、扉を開けるだけでは政策とは言えない」と苦言を呈する。中国に安易に歩み寄るべきだとは思わないとし、台湾有事発言の撤回も必要ないとする一方、「しっかりとした日本の対中戦略が求められる」と指摘。中国経済が悪化したことで、中国では日本企業の重要性や価値が再認識されているとし、半導体関連技術など日本の強みを駆使した戦略を描くべきだと述べた。

中国は米中首脳会談後の９月下旬、民間団体の会長として訪中した岩屋毅前外相を受け入れ、王毅外相や何立峰副首相らが会談に応じた。政権の外交に精通する政府関係者は、「高市氏とは話さないが、『良識のある』政権が誕生すればいつでも対話に応じるというのが、いまの中国のスタンスだ」と分析。峯村氏も「高市氏とその他の勢力を分け、その他を中国に取り込むことで高市氏を孤立させる戦略だ」と解説した。

高市外交２年目の成否を左右するポイントとして、峯村氏は「日本政府としてしっかりとした対中戦略を描けるのかどうか」を挙げた。一方、ロイターの取材に答えた政府関係者３人はいずれも悲観的で、こう口をそろえた。「高市政権下での日中の関係改善は難しいだろう」

政権の対中戦略について、木原稔官房長官は２０日の記者会見で、中国は重要な隣国だとの認識を改めて示した上で、「戦略的互恵関係を包括的に推進する」との従来からの姿勢を強調。懸案があるからこそ意思疎通が重要になるとし、「国益を守るための対話を進め、建設的かつ安定的な関係を構築していく」と述べた。

（鬼原民幸　編集：橋本浩）

＊インタビュー詳細：日本は対中戦略描け　「日本企業の価値」にヒント＝ＣＩＧＳ峯村氏

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Erin Banco　Jonathan Landay　Tom Balmforth

[ニューヨーク／ワシントン／ロンドン　１９日　ロイター] - 米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使は、ロシア・ウクライナ戦争の終結に向け協議するため週内にノルウェーを訪問する。関係筋３人が明らかにした。

同筋のうち２人は、 ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領も会合に参加する見通しだと述べた。事情に詳しい別の関係筋によると、協議に参加する予定だったトランプ米大統領の娘婿ジャレッド・クシュナー氏は体調を崩しており、オンラインで参加する。

オスロでの協議には、ゼレンスキー氏、ノルウェーのストーレ首相、英国・フランス・ドイツ・ポーランドで構成される「Ｅ４」の代表者、欧州連合（ＥＵ）、北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）が参加する見通し。

また、関係筋２人によると、ウィットコフ氏はロシアを訪れ、 プーチン大統領と会談する予定。ロシア側との協議では、ウクライナに関連する幅広いトピックに加え、２０２２年にロシアで収監された米国人スティーブン・ハバード氏の釈放についても焦点が当てられる。

いずれの関係筋も、この予定は暫定的なもので、変更される可能性があるとしている。

ゼレンスキー氏は１９日の早い段階で、ウクライナと米国の交渉担当者が数日中にノルウェーで会談する可能性があると述べていた。

この件についてホワイトハウスからコメントは得られていない。

ゼレンスキー氏は、米国の政策判断によりウクライナが戦場で利用している衛星通信システム「スターシールド」の通信速度が低下させられたほか、米国による情報共有も制限されていると主張。米政府当局者はいずれも否定しており、米国とウクライナの間で緊張が高まっている。

item.title: インタビュー：日本は対中戦略描け 「日本企業の価値」にヒント＝ＣＩＧＳ峯村氏
item.description:
Tamiyuki Kihara
[東京 ２０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Tamiyuki Kihara

[東京 ２０日 ロイター] - 高市早苗政権が発足して２１日で１年となる。外交面で特に厳しさを増したのが日中関係だ。昨年１１月、高市氏が国会で台湾有事が日本の存立危機事態になり得ると発言して以降、両国関係に改善の兆しは見えない。キヤノングローバル戦略研究所（ＣＩＧＳ）上席研究員兼中国研究センター長の峯村健司氏に、高市氏の対中外交への評価と課題、そして政権２年目の成否を左右する外交戦略上のポイントを聞いた。

──高市外交の対中政策をどう評価しているか。

高市首相は中国に対して「対話の扉は開いている」と言うが、扉を開けるだけでは政策とは言えない。安倍晋三元首相は中国に厳しい立場を取る一方で、当時の二階俊博幹事長や今井尚哉首相秘書官らを通じて中国との対話を重ね、「飴」と「鞭」の戦略を描いていた。安倍氏が私に「二階さんがいるからこそ習近平国家主席を堂々と批判できる」と言っていたのを思い出す。それに比べて、高市政権は誰がどのような対中戦略を描いているのかがまったく見えない。

──最近の中国の対日姿勢に変化は見えないか。

中国が高市氏の存立危機事態発言について「撤回」ではなく「是正」を求めると発信し始めたのは５月のことだ。そのタイミングで中国の対日戦略は大きく変わった。５月以前は習氏の指示で対日強硬政策が進められ、デュアルユース、軍民融合品の輸出規制や訪日旅行の自粛が打ち出された。高市政権を早期に終わらせるための政策だった。しかし、支持率は思うように下がらず、２月の衆院選で自民党は大勝した。また、日米同盟にくさびを打とうと、５月の北京での米中首脳会談で習氏は高市氏を名指しで批判し、「新型軍国主義」だとのレッテル貼りを試みた。ところが、トランプ氏は直後に大統領専用機エアフォース・ワンから高市氏に電話をして内容を報告した。習氏は、戦略を変えなければならないと感じたことだろう。

──中国の戦略はどう変わったのか。

５月から、中国は「統一戦線工作」に打って出た。高市氏とその他の勢力を分け、その他を中国に取り込むことで高市氏を孤立させる戦略だ。９月に岩屋毅前外相と同行した日系企業を厚遇したのもその一環だ。岩屋氏と何立峰副首相との会談の同席者に聞いたところ、何氏は満面の笑みで「経済交流は重要だ」と語ったという。前日の会談で厳しい姿勢を示した王毅外相を「鞭」、何氏を「飴」として使い分けた証左だ。その後の会見で中国が高市氏を「日本の首相」という肩書も付けずに呼び捨てにしたように、中国の対日強硬姿勢はむしろ強まっているのだ。

──高市政権はどう動くべきか。

私は中国に安易に歩み寄るべきだとは思わない。存立危機事態発言も撤回する必要はない。一方で、しっかりとした日本の対中戦略が求められる。中国経済が悪化する現状にあって、中国では日本企業の重要性や価値が再認識されている。日本には半導体関連技術などの強みもある。こうしたアセットをうまく駆使した戦略が必要だ。

──１１月にはアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）が控えている。

ＡＰＥＣで中国は、「日本は新型軍国主義だ」とのキャンペーンを各国に対して展開する可能性がある。中国が米中ロの首脳会談を模索しているのも、同じ文脈だ。日本政府はこうした中国の動きに警戒感を強める必要がある。中国の動きを封じるためにも、日米関係の一層の強化が必要だ。日米がしっかり連携できていれば、中国のキャンペーンの試みは成功しない。もっとも、トランプ氏に頼むだけでは限界がある。日本政府としてしっかりとした対中戦略を描けるのかどうかが、高市政権２年目の成否を左右する。

（聞き手・鬼原民幸　編集：橋本浩）

＊関連記事：〔アングル〕期待と誤算に揺れた日中の１年　高市政権下の改善「難しい」と関係者

item.title: Chinese patrols to Taiwan's east are 'destabilising', US Congress-appointed official says
item.description: Chinese coast guard patrols to the east of Taiwan are "highly destabilising" and an extension of Beijing's legal, political and information warfare against Taipei, the chair of a US congressional committee said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Ben Blanchard
item.content:encoded: Chinese coast guard patrols to the east of Taiwan are "highly destabilising" and an extension of Beijing's legal, political and information warfare against Taipei, the chair of a US congressional committee said on Tuesday. China, which views Taiwan as its own territory, has stepped up activity off the island's [USN:L1N42902N TEXT:"east coast"] since June with regular coast guard patrols. China recognises no claims of sovereignty by Taiwan, including over the seas around the island. Officials in Taiwan, which rejects Beijing's territorial claims, say they believe China is practising for a possible maritime blockade using overlapping military, paramilitary and civilian assets. Speaking at a forum in Taipei, Randall Schriver, chair of the US Congress' US-China Economic and Security Review Commission, said one of the most troubling recent developments he had seen was the idea of a persistent coast guard patrol east of Taiwan. While the idea of an ostensibly civilian vessel performing law enforcement duties could seem benign, in fact it is an extension of China's sovereignty claim, he added. "This is an extension of legal warfare and political and information warfare. This is highly destabilising if they continue to operationalise this law enforcement role." China's foreign ministry reiterated comments from last week that those waters were Chinese and it was "therefore legitimate, lawful and beyond reproach for China to carry out activities" there. Speaking at the same event, National Security Council Secretary-General Joseph Wu said China had no legal claim to the waters off the island's east. DELAYED US ARMS SALES The United States is Taiwan's most important international backer and arms supplier, despite the lack of formal diplomatic ties. However, US President Donald Trump has [USN:L1N41S025 TEXT:"yet to approve"] a new $14 billion arms package for Taiwan, saying in May after meeting Chinese President Xi Jinping in Beijing that such sales were a "very good negotiating chip". In December, Trump approved $11 billion of arms for Taiwan. Schriver, a former US assistant secretary of defense, said Trump overall had a good record on approving weapons sales to Taiwan and providing military training. But with Trump and Xi most likely due to meet twice more this year, at the APEC summit in China and the G20 in Florida, there would probably only be movement on the new package next year, he added. "I think they'll find a way, whether it's splitting the package up or reimagining some of it as DCS or FMS," Schriver said, referring to direct commercial sales and foreign military sales. "And I know that the support is there again in Congress and from much of the bureaucracy."

item.title: UCLA’s Nico Iamaleava has ‘severe’ knee injury that requires surgery
item.description: UCLA head coach Bob Chesney stopped short of saying starting quarterback Nico Iamaleava would miss the rest of the 2026 season when he spoke with reporters on Monday, but reading between the lines suggests little hope for a fast return.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: UCLA head coach Bob Chesney stopped short of saying starting quarterback Nico Iamaleava would miss the rest of the 2026 season when he spoke with reporters on Monday, but reading between the lines suggests little hope for a fast return. "Nico, he's going to be out," Chesney said. "It's severe. He's probably going to have surgery coming up here today or tomorrow." The ninth-ranked Bruins have been navigating life without their star passer since Iamaleava was injured late in the first half of their 17-15 win against the Oregon Ducks on Oct. 10. The signal-caller was hit by two Oregon defenders on a scramble which ended up twisting his left leg. Iamaleava briefly tried to return to the game but didn't return after halftime. UCLA started backup Ty Dieffenbach in a 17-7 win last weekend against Wisconsin that elevated the Bruins to 6-0 (4-0 Big Ten) under their first-year head coach. Dieffenbach was 22-of-33 passing for 264 yards with one interception. CBS reported that Iamaleava could miss the remainder of the season with a torn ACL on Oct. 12. Chesney's comments seemed to confirm that reporting. The Tennessee transfer was in his second season with the Bruins, throwing for 982 yards, four touchdowns and four interceptions. He added 144 yards and a touchdown on the ground. --Field Level Media

item.title: 午前の日経平均は続落、ＡＩ株の一角に売り継続 下げ渋りも
item.description:
Hiroko Hamada
[東京 ２０日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は続落し、前営業日比０．６２％...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
午前の日経平均は続落、ＡＩ株の一角に売り継続　下げ渋りも 11:59 配信

写真は2026年4月、東京証券取引所内で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

Hiroko Hamada

[東京 ２０日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は続落し、前営業日比０．６２％（４０４円３５銭）安の６万４５１２円３５銭となった。人工知能（ＡＩ）向けクラウドサービスを手がける米コアウィーブを巡る懸念がくすぶる中、引き続きＡＩ関連株の一角が安く、日経平均は軟調な展開となった。原油価格の高止まりや米金利高も投資家心理の重しとなった。日経平均は一時１％超安となったが、一部半導体株に買い戻しも入り、終盤は下げ渋った。

・日経平均は前営業日比０．２５％安でスタートした後、一時１．５７％（１０２２円）安の６万３８９４円６７銭まで下落。

・寄与度の大きいＡＩ・半導体関連株の下げが強まった。韓国株安も重し。個別ではソフトバンクグループ、フジクラが大幅下落。

・売りが一巡した後は一部半導体株がプラスに転じ、日経平均は下げ幅を縮小。終盤にかけては６万４５００円台でもみ合い。

・物色面では銀行株が軟調。決算を手掛かりにした売買も。

・ＴＯＰＩＸは０．８８％安の４０３１．８５ポイントで午前の取引を終了。東証プライム市場の売買代金は３兆０８２１億６８００万円。

・東証３３業種では、鉄鋼、その他製品、精密機器など５業種が値上がり。非鉄金属、銀行、海運など２８業種が値下がり。

・東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが２５６銘柄（１６％）、値下がりは１２５４銘柄（８０％）、変わらずは４１銘柄（２％）。

＜いちよし証券　投資情報部　銘柄情報課課長　及川敬司氏＞

「米コアウィーブのような新興企業の資金繰り懸念がくすぶっているが、半導体製造装置や素材関連株がいっしょくたに売られているのは違和感もある。これから本格化する決算で好業績が確認されれば、（半導体関連株に）買い戻しが入る可能性もある」

「目先は金融政策会合や米中間選挙などイベントを控え、動きづらくなりそうだが、イベント通過後は再び上方向を試す展開を想定」

item.title: Gavin McKenna nets winning goal as Maple Leafs top Sharks
item.description: Gavin McKenna netted the game-winning goal as the Toronto Maple Leafs beat the San Jose Sharks 3-1 on Monday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Gavin McKenna netted the game-winning goal as the Toronto Maple Leafs beat the San Jose Sharks 3-1 on Monday night. McKenna put the Leafs up 2-1 4:56 into the final frame, receiving the puck from Auston Matthews on the outside and enjoying a relatively unimpeded path towards goal. The 18-year-old was allowed to stroll towards the net and ping it in off the post for his first power-play goal in the NHL. The game marked the first encounter between McKenna and Ivar Stenberg -- the highly touted top-two picks of the 2026 NHL entry draft. Mason Marchment scored in the first period for San Jose before Matthews tied the game with 12 seconds remaining in the second period. Matthews added two assists for his fourth multi-point game of the young season. Sergei Bobrovsky stopped 30 shots in his first home win as a Maple Leaf. Yaroslav Askarov made 29 saves for the visitors. Marchment opened the scoring 13:54 in. Tyler Toffoli snatched up Toronto's clearing attempt at the point and flipped the puck to Marchment lurking behind the play. The former Maple Leaf pulled the puck out of the air and shoveled it over a sprawling Bobrovsky. The Sharks were able to kill off a 58-second five-on-three towards the end of the first period after Jacob Trouba and Dmitry Orlov were called for consecutive tripping penalties. Matthews tied the game 1-1 at the end of the second period on what was Toronto's fourth power play. Kirill Marchenko spun away from Trouba in the corner and slipped the puck to the captain, who ripped in a powerful one-timer from one knee. Macklin Celebrini was responsible for the penalty after jumping onto the ice too early, resulting in a too-many-men call. Nick Paul sealed the deal on an empty-net goal with less than 40 seconds remaining from just inside the offensive zone. The Sharks are one of two teams still without a regulation win on the season. --Field Level Media

item.description:
Wen-Yee Lee
[台北 ２０日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手マイクロン・テクノロジーの台湾・桃園拠点で働く従...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米マイクロンの台湾・桃園労組、22日にスト開始　賞与巡り対立 11:56 配信

写真はマイクロン・テクノロジーの看板。2026年9月、台湾桃園市で撮影。REUTERS/Ann Wang

Wen-Yee Lee

[台北 ２０日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手マイクロン・テクノロジーの台湾・桃園拠点で働く従業員を代表する労働組合は、２２日にストライキを開始すると発表した。同社と、台中拠点の従業員を代表する別の労組との間で行われる交渉に合わせて行われるもので、賞与を巡る対立が激化している。

マイクロンにとって、人工知能（ＡＩ）サーバーの主要部品であるＤＲＡＭや広帯域メモリー（ＨＢＭ）を生産する最も重要な製造拠点の一つ。

桃園の労組はストについて、台中の労組との連帯を示すとともに、マイクロンに対し具体的な利益配分案を提示するよう圧力を強めることを目的としていると述べた。

マイクロンは台湾で約１万５０００人を雇用しており、桃園と台中の各事業部門の労働者を代表する別々の労組が存在する。

マイクロンと桃園労組との間の交渉は９月、合意に至らずに終了。同労組は１０月上旬、組合員からスト実施の承認を得た。

台湾で最大規模のマイクロン拠点の従業員を代表する台中労組は、現在も同社と交渉を続けている。同労組は、スト実施の是非に関する投票をまだ行っていない。

桃園労組はスト期間については明らかにしておらず、２２日に詳細を発表するとしている。

台湾の頼清徳総統は先週、労使双方に誠実な交渉を呼びかけた。

item.title: Seoul vows 'resolute punishment' after North Korea threatens new border measures
item.description: South Korea on Tuesday vowed a stern response if North Korea acts on threats to strengthen its military posture along the border, which have fueled tensions on the Korean Peninsula.
item.dc:creator: Kyu-Seok Shim
item.content:encoded: South Korea on Tuesday vowed a stern response if North Korea acts on threats to strengthen its military posture along the border, which have fueled tensions on the Korean Peninsula. In a statement, Seoul's Defence Ministry expressed grave concern over Pyongyang's [USN:L1N46509I TEXT:"threats"] to deploy additional tactical strike weapons along the border and resume loudspeaker broadcasts towards the South. The escalation and exchange of threats has raised the possibility of clashes along the heavily armed border and undercuts diplomatic gains made by South Korean President Lee Jae Myung soon after he took office. The ministry said South Korea's broadcasts and warning shots near the Military Demarcation Line (MDL) were a "legitimate defensive measure" aimed at preventing incursions and forcing North Korean troops who crossed the line to withdraw. "If North Korea uses our legitimate measures as a pretext to carry out further provocations, we will punish it resolutely,” the ministry said. It urged Pyongyang to stop making what it called groundless claims, halt incursions across the MDL and respond to efforts to resolve differences between the two sides over the line. 'CLEAR PROVOCATION' Seoul's Joint Chiefs of Staff Chairman Jin Young-seung reviewed military readiness while visiting a frontline army command, and ordered operations aimed at strengthening Seoul’s initiative in the Demilitarized Zone, its military said in a separate statement. "We cannot tolerate North Korea falsely characterising our legitimate operational measures as provocations and shifting responsibility for heightened military tensions onto our military,” Jin said. He said North Korea was responsible for planting landmines south of the MDL that seriously wounded South Korean soldiers last month, calling the incident “a clear provocation” and a violation of the armistice agreement. The warnings from Seoul came after North Korea’s Kim Yo Jong, sister of leader Kim Jong Un, accused the South Korean military of endangering North Korean soldiers by firing warning shots during Pyongyang’s work to fortify the border. Her threat to revive North Korean loudspeaker broadcasts risks reversing a key de-escalation [USN:L1N3TW05E TEXT:"measure"] that South Korean President Lee Jae Myung has touted as an early achievement of his efforts to restart diplomacy with Pyongyang. North Korea has been installing mines and barriers along the border since April 2024. South Korea said this month that Pyongyang had deployed as many as 7,000 workers to the area this year and that North Korean personnel had crossed the MDL on about 50 occasions. Analysts said the standoff increased the risk of a military clash. "If North Korea’s threshold falls below South Korea’s existing rules of engagement, the simple repetition of current procedures could be enough to create the conditions for a clash,” said Hong Min, a senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification. Michael Bosack, founding director of the Parley Policy Institute and a former UN Command official, said troops could mistake warning shots for missed attacks, risking “misinterpretation of intent and potential counterfires.”

item.description: [１９日 ロイター] - ９月の欧州バッテリー式電気自動車（ＢＥＶ）登録台数は前年同月比７０．３％増加した。原油高や補...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州ＥＶ登録、9月は前年比70.3％増　シェア30％超 11:50 配信

写真は小鵬汽車のEV「G9L」。2026年10月12日、パリモーターショーで撮影。REUTERS/Benoit Tessier

[１９日 ロイター] - ９月の欧州バッテリー式電気自動車（ＢＥＶ）登録台数は前年同月比７０．３％増加した。原油高や補助金、手頃な価格の車種拡充が引き続き伸びをけん引した。

Ｅモビリティー・ヨーロッパ、ニュー・オートモーティブ、フィア・オートモーティブが１９日公表したデータによると、フランスとドイツが欧州連合（ＥＵ）の自動車排ガス規制案の緩和で合意する中、欧州主要１７市場で９月に販売された自動車の約３分の１をＢＥＶが占めた。

・９月のＢＥＶ登録台数は３０万０２０２台、市場シェアは３２．６％となった。

・欧州における年初来の累計登録台数は１９８万台で、２０２５年の同期間から３８．１％増加した。

・国別では、フランスが６万５２４３台で市場シェアは４１．７％、ドイツは８万８７２４台で、シェアは３４．６％となった。

・北欧は引き続き欧州で電動化が最も進んだ市場となった。ＢＥＶの市場シェアはノルウェーが９８．８％で首位、次いでデンマークの８８．８％、フィンランドの６２．７％、スウェーデンの４９．０％となった。

・アイルランド、ポルトガル、ベルギー、オランダでは、登録台数の約半数をＢＥＶが占めた。

・チェコ、イタリア、ポーランドは引き続き欧州で最も電動化が遅れている市場に入り、ＢＥＶのシェアはそれぞれ１１．２％、７．６％、６．２％だった。

item.title: Trump thanks ‘legendary’ friend Elon Musk for pledging SpaceX shares to every American child through Trump Accounts
item.description: Donald Trump thanked Elon Musk for pledging one SpaceX share to every American child next year through Trump Accounts. The proposed donation could be worth about $10.7 billion, though details of how the shares will be distributed remain unclear.
item.dc:creator: Swati Gandhi
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump on Monday (local time) thanked billionaire Elon Musk after Musk announced plans to donate shares in his company SpaceX to millions of American children through the Trump administration’s flagship "Trump Accounts" initiative.In a social media post, Trump wrote, "A BIG THANK YOU to our legendary friend, ElonMusk, for his incredible generosity in giving SpaceX Stock to millions of American children through TRUMP ACCOUNTS! This is exactly what was envisioned when we created TRUMP ACCOUNTS — bringing together the GREAT PRIVATE SECTOR, Elon and so many more, to invest in our children, by far our greatest and most important asset, and give every American Child a piece of the American Dream."Musk commits shares to American children: What we knowHis remarks came after SpaceX founder Musk wrote in a post on X, “Next year, I will give one of my SpaceX shares to every kid in America. This will be the first of many.”According to Bloomberg, Musk has agreed to distribute the stock through the Trump Accounts initiative, though he has not disclosed how the donation would be structured. Citing a source, the report said he decided to proceed after the White House announced the creation of tens of millions of accounts through automatic enrolment. Earlier this month, the White House said every American child under 18 with a valid Social Security number now has a Trump Account.Estimates from the US Census Bureau show that the US has around 72 million children, which would make Musk’s donation worth about $10.7 billion at the current share price.Musk joins the list of high-profile Trump Accounts backersThe SpaceX founder’s planned donation adds another high-profile name to the list of Trump Accounts backers. Billionaires including Michael and Susan Dell and Bridgewater Associates founder Ray Dalio have previously pledged funds.The announcement comes nearly three months after the US president said in July that he expected Musk to contribute to the Trump Accounts programme. Around the same time, SpaceX President Gwynne Shotwell announced that she and her husband had gifted SpaceX stock to Trump Accounts for more than 2 million children in the US.What are Trump Accounts?According to the official website, Trump Accounts are tax-advantaged investment accounts for American children under the age of 18.Established through a tax and spending bill that Trump signed last year, the programme provides $1,000 each to eligible American children born between 2025 and 2028. It allows families, government programmes and private-sector donors to contribute funds and equities directly to eligible children’s accounts. The aim is to give children under 18 an early financial foundation and a stake in the country’s enterprise.Under the programme, money in eligible accounts stays invested until recipients reach adulthood, giving it the potential to grow over time. Since opening on 4 July, the accounts have received more than $4.5 billion, including $2.6 billion in philanthropic contributions, $1.3 billion in initial $1,000 seed contributions and over $600 million from relatives and friends. According to reports, the accounts are expected to receive further contributions soon.Family and friends can contribute up to $5,000 a year to each child’s account. Employers may provide up to $2,500 annually, which counts towards that limit. Eligible children can also receive philanthropic contributions, while more than 70 companies have pledged to set up workplace contribution programmes.(with agency inputs)

item.title: Australian barber hailed as hero for running to lawmaker's rescue during attack
item.description: Australian barber Ricky Jefferies has been hailed as a hero for running out of his store to detain a man who authorities allege deliberately drove a car into lawmaker Helen Haines in the small town of Wangaratta, an incident that has shocked the country.
item.dc:creator: Christine Chen
item.content:encoded: Australian barber Ricky Jefferies has been hailed as a hero for running out of his store to detain a man who authorities allege deliberately drove a car into lawmaker Helen Haines in the small town of Wangaratta, an incident that has shocked the country. Jefferies had just finished haircuts for a young family on Monday when he said he heard a "loud bang" outside his shop and realised the driver of a Toyota LandCruiser had [USN:L1N46508R TEXT:"struck Haines, "]leaving her badly injured. "It was crazy, I just ran out the front to see what was happening," he told reporters on Tuesday. He said he ran to assist the well-respected local MP, grabbing a knife from the alleged attacker's pocket and pulling him out of the car. "He did have a knife. He didn't pull it out. I just wasn't comfortable with his movements, and so I basically just took it out of his pocket and threw it away," he said. Jefferies said he then held the man down until police arrived. "I just leant over him and once he was on the ground and he was no longer a threat, I just stood with him and I told him that he can't leave," he said. Haines, 65, was airlifted to hospital where she underwent surgery overnight. She [USN:L1N46510F TEXT:"remains in a critical condition"]. Early investigations suggested the driver, identified as a 43-year-old man, performed a U-turn before hitting Haines as she was loading or unloading things from the trunk of her car, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said. Counterterrorism authorities are among the multiple agencies involved in the investigation. While police have given no motive for the alleged attack, the involvement of counterterrorism investigators has raised alarm that it could have been an act of political violence, which is rare in Australia. Jefferies, whose shop is next door to Haines' electorate office around three hours' drive northeast of Melbourne, described the former midwife as a "genuine, kind person". Albanese praised Jefferies' intervention, calling him a hero. "At this dark and terrible time, an element of light is the fact that a Good Samaritan, someone rushed to Helen's defence in Wangaratta, put themselves potentially at risk by doing so. And that person is a hero today," Albanese said in an interview with the Nine network's "Today" show. Jefferies downplayed the praise. "I don't think I'm a hero. I think that I just was a person who had an opportunity to intervene in a safe-ish sort of way," he said.

item.description:
Echo Wang Krystal Hu Sabrina Valle
[ニューヨーク １９日 ロイター] - 米人工知...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
オープンＡＩ、アンソロピックＩＰＯ控え資金調達を加速＝関係筋 11:29 配信

写真はオープンＡＩのロゴ。2026年6月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Echo Wang　Krystal Hu　Sabrina Valle

[ニューヨーク １９日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業オープンＡＩは、競合アンソロピックが１１月中旬に予定している上場に先立ち、投資家からのコミットメントを確保するために急ピッチで動いている。関係筋２人が明らかにした。オープンＡＩの企業価値は１兆４０００億ドルを超えるとみられているという。

同筋によると、オープンＡＩは似たような投資家層を取り込んでいるアンソロピックに先んじたいという意向を持っているほか、新モデルのリリースを受けた最近の収益成長を生かしたいと考えている。

同筋の１人は、ソフトバンクグループ、アブダビに拠点を置くＭＧＸ、オープンＡＩのその他の既存出資者が約３００億ドル規模の資金調達ラウンドへの参加について協議していると明らかにした。

オープンＡＩは先週、ロングオンリーファンドや政府系ファンドと面会。一方、アンソロピックは独自のインベスター・デーを開催していた。関係筋によると、オープンＡＩの資金調達ラウンドは、この規模の案件としては異例なほど迅速に進む見通し。

同社に詳しい投資家によると、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）市場の悪化により２０２７年に予定されている上場がさらに遅れる場合、オープンＡＩは巨額のインフラ投資を賄い、バランスシートを強化するためにも資金が必要だという。

オープンＡＩ、ソフトバンクＧはコメントを控えた。アンソロピックとＭＧＸはコメント要請に応じていない。

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
インドネシア株式市場は10月19日、2営業日の下落としては過去最大を記録した。指数算出会社MSCIが16日、2027年に同国を「新興国市場」から除外すると警告したことが売りを誘発した。「スタンドアローン市場」に変更された場合、レバノンやアルゼンチン、ジンバブエと同分類になる。インドネシアは長年新興国市場の有望株だったが、近年は重要性が低下し、指数における比率は大幅に低下した。指数からの除外は、多くの海外投資家の撤退を招く。

アジア金融・市場記者 アンクル・バネルジー

インドネシア株式市場は19日、2営業日の下落としては過去最大を記録した。

指数算出会社MSCIが16日、2027年に同国を「新興国市場」から除外すると警告したことが売りを誘発した。 「新興国市場」から「スタンドアローン市場」に変更された場合、レバノンやアルゼンチン、ジンバブエと同分類になる。 MSCIは1月、スタンドアローン市場への再分類を警告しており、投資家や当局は明らかに苦慮している。

インドネシアは長年新興国市場の有望株だったが、近年は重要性が低下し、指数における比率は大幅に低下した。 指数からの除外は、多くの海外投資家の撤退を招く。市場への関心を失った投資家が一斉に資金を引き上げるためだ。 1月にMSCIはインドネシアの投資適格性に懸念を提起した。主な懸念は株主構造の不透明さや実質的保有者に関する問題だった。不自然な協調取引の動きも懸念材料となっている。 インドネシア当局からは多くの改革案が発表されたが、10月16日、MSCIは改革後も、市場機能不全の重大な疑念が残ると述べた。 フロンティア市場への再分類では不十分だと判断し、スタンドアローン（独立）市場への再分類を検討すると発表。これは、予想外の最悪のシナリオだ。当局に行動を起こさせる大きな理由となっている。 MSCIが発表済みの改革案に満足していないのは明らかだ。改革を一歩前進と評価しつつ、さらなる対応を期待している。

規制当局は一環として、上場3社の実質的保有者への罰金を発表した。違反者に対するこのような処罰は今後も増える見通しだ。 注目すべきは、通貨インドネシアルピアや債券市場への影響だ。ルピアはすでに過去最安値圏まで下落している。原油価格の100ドル超えが、さらなる重圧となっている。 アジア経済に圧力がかかる中、インドネシアも例外ではない。アジア通貨全般に圧力がかかり、インドネシアも大きな打撃を受けている。 一連の課題から、MSCIとの問題は深刻な亀裂を生む可能性がある。投資家はそれを深く懸念し、注視している。

item.title: 再送-サッカー＝上田所属リール、公式ショップで略奪被害 仏国内の騒乱受け
item.description:
(見出しを修正しました)
［１９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
(見出しを修正しました)

［１９日　ロイター］ - サッカーのフランス１部、上田綺世が所属するリールは、国内各地で週末に発生した騒乱により、クラブ公式ショップが略奪被害を受けたと明らかにした。マルセイユも同様の被害を報告している。

フランスでは物価高騰や公共サービスの低下に抗議するデモが暴徒化し、数千人が逮捕されたほか、店舗が略奪や破壊の被害に遭うなど近年で最悪級の騒乱が発生した。

リールは１７日に市中心部にある公式ショップが深刻な破壊行為と略奪に遭い、追って通知があるまで営業を休止すると発表した。

マルセイユも１９日、市中心部にある公式ショップへの暴力行為や略奪を強く非難する声明を発表。当局は同日、市内全域で正午から午後８時まで集会やデモを禁止する措置を講じた。

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝ヤンキースのブーン監督、来季も続投へ─報道
item.description: ［１９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１９日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）公式サイトは１９日、ヤンキースのアーロン・ブーン監督が来季も続投することを情報筋の話として伝えた。

ブーン監督は２０１８年からヤンキースを率い、９シーズンで８回のプレーオフ進出と３回のア・リーグ東地区優勝を達成。２４年にはア・リーグ優勝を果たしてワールドシリーズに進出したが、ドジャースに敗れた。

今季は９３勝６８敗の東地区２位でプレーオフに進んだものの、地区シリーズでレイズに３連敗を喫して敗退していた。９シーズンの通算成績は７９０勝５６５敗。

シーズン終盤は故障のためプレーオフを含めて欠場が続いた主砲のアーロン・ジャッジ外野手は敗退決定後、ブーン監督の続投を前提とした上で球団フロントに対して「勝負に出る（全力を尽くして補強などを行う）」ことを求めていた。

item.title: ＮＢＡ＝ミラー、ホーネッツと5年331億円で契約延長合意─報道
item.description: ［１９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１９日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）のブランドン・ミラーが、ホーネッツと５年総額２億９００万ドル（約３３１億円）で契約延長に合意したと、複数のメディアが１９日に報じた。

１１月で２４歳となるミラーは２０２３年のドラフト全体２位でホーネッツから指名。３年目の昨シーズンは６５試合に出場して１試合平均２０．２得点、４．９リバウンド、３．３アシストを記録したほか、キャリアハイとなる２０４本の３点シュートを成功させた。通算成績は１６６試合（うち１６０試合で先発）の出場で、１試合平均１９．０得点、４．６リバウンド、３．０アシスト。

今オフは左肩の手術を受けたものの、開幕に向けての準備は順調に進んでいる。ラメロ・ボールがティンバーウルブズへトレードされたことを受け、ホーネッツのチーム再建における中心的な存在として期待されている。

item.title: US to launch $8 billion support program for farmers to offset diesel costs, Trump says
item.description: President Donald Trump said on Monday the US Department of Agriculture will launch what he called a new "harvest fuel relief program" that will provide farmers with $8 billion in support to offset diesel costs during the harvest season.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump said on Monday the US Department of Agriculture will launch what he called a new "harvest fuel relief program" that will provide farmers with $8 billion in support to offset diesel costs during the harvest season. "Tonight, I'm also pleased to announce that the Department of Agriculture will be launching a new harvest fuel relief program, providing our farmers with $8 billion in support to offset diesel costs during this harvest season," Trump said in a midterm election campaign speech in Kansas. The announcement was the latest in a [USN:FWN45O0AV TEXT:"series of financial promises"] and pledges that the Republican leader [USN:L6N45S110 TEXT:"has made to voters"] heading into the November midterm elections, where control of Congress is at stake. The Republican Party currently has a narrow majority in both the Senate and the House of Representatives. However, Trump's approval rating [USN:L6N465159 TEXT:"has been low"] due to his handling of the high cost of living for Americans during the US-Israeli war on Iran that has raised fuel prices. Trump and the Republican Party have been scrambling to maintain support in farm states with competitive Senate races as costs have risen. Trump signed an [USN:FWN45R168 TEXT:"executive order earlier this month"] that he said would expand access to tax-exempt diesel. The Department of Agriculture said after Trump's speech on Monday that it would make $8 billion available "for one-time payments to American farmers this harvest season to provide relief during temporary market disruptions and increased input costs." The program will provide what the department called "proportional support to producers using a uniform formula to cover a portion of modeled losses during the 2026 crop year." The $8 billion in payments would be administered by the department's Farm Service Agency, the department said. Trump has also separately proposed sending [USN:L6N45211D TEXT:"$5,000 checks"] to all adult citizens if Republicans keep control of the House and Senate in the midterms, though analysts, economists and even some Republicans in Congress have reacted with skepticism. Earlier this month, Trump said the US government would send a [USN:FWN45O0AV TEXT:"one-time payment of $90"] to more than 20 million Americans enrolled in Medicare, a health insurance program for the elderly.

item.title: Matvei Michkov tallies twice versus Avs as Flyers win second straight
item.description: Matvei Michkov scored twice and Trevor Zegras notched three assists as the Philadelphia Flyers nipped the visiting Colorado Avalanche 3-2 on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Matvei Michkov scored twice and Trevor Zegras notched three assists as the Philadelphia Flyers nipped the visiting Colorado Avalanche 3-2 on Monday. Joseph Woll made 24 saves for Philadelphia, which played without injured regulars Travis Konecny, Tyson Foerster, Owen Tippett, Cam York and Rasmus Ristolainen. The Flyers have won back-to-back games since opening their season with nine straight winless outings. Martin Necas and T.J. Hughes tallied for Colorado, which has alternated wins and losses in its last eight games. Mackenzie Blackwood turned aside 21 shots for the Avalanche. Michkov opened the scoring with a power-play goal 7:41 into the contest. Zegras took a shot that caromed to Michkov in the opposite circle and he buried it to mark his third straight game with a goal. Michkov made it 2-0 at 12:23 of the second period on a play where he carried the puck behind the net, then through the circle and back near the blue line. He then wristed a shot toward the net, where Noah Cates was setting up a screen, and the puck slipped past Blackwood for his sixth of the year. However, Necas responded less than six minutes later with a shot from the top of the right circle that beat Woll, moments after an Avalanche power play had ended. The goal was the fifth of the season for Necas, who had taken a puck to the mouth earlier in the game. Noel Acciari made it 3-1 at 6:34 of the third period with a deflection off a point shot by Oliver Bonk. It was the first goal as a Flyer for Acciari, who scored 13 times for the Pittsburgh Penguins a season ago. The Avalanche got within 3-2 with 5:20 remaining as Hughes grabbed a loose puck in the right circle and snapped one past a helpless Woll. Colorado pulled Blackwood with two minutes left and the visitors controlled the puck for the duration of the game. Michkov's icing with just under a minute to go caused some tense moments down the stretch with a group of tired skaters, but Philadelphia held on. --Field Level Media

item.title: ロシュ、今後のドイツ向け投資を全面保留 医療費削減提案で
item.description: [フランクフルト １９日 ロイター] - スイス製薬大手ロシュは、ドイツの医療費削減政策に関連して今後の同国への投資を...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ロシュ、今後のドイツ向け投資を全面保留　医療費削減提案で 11:10 配信

写真はロシュのロゴ。2020年1月、スイス・バーゼルで撮影。REUTERS/Arnd Wiegmann

[フランクフルト １９日 ロイター] - スイス製薬大手ロシュは、ドイツの医療費削減政策に関連して今後の同国への投資を全面的に見直している。ドイツ医薬品事業の責任者ダニエル・シュタイナーズ氏が１９日、ウェルト紙のインタビューで明らかにした。

シュタイナーズ氏は「ドイツにおける今後の投資決定を当面全て保留にしている」と述べ、政策立案者らが最近、製薬業界に対し「多くの信頼を損ねた」と付け加えた。

• ドイツ連邦保健省報道官は「ドイツを事業拠点としないとの企業の決定は遺憾で、わが国と欧州連合（ＥＵ）がこれらの課題を真剣に受け止めなければならないことを示している」と語った。

• 同省は欧州レベルでの交渉を含め、ドイツおよび欧州における製薬業界のための安定的かつ魅力的な枠組み条件の整備を提唱していくという。

• シュタイナーズ氏は、政策立案者らが法定健康保険制度の構造的な問題に取り組む代わりに短期的な経費節減に注力し、業界にさらなる負担を強いていると指摘した。

• 同氏は、研究・生産に従事する製薬企業の製造業者割引に関する負担軽減を目的とした立地条項の提案は、この法律による悪影響を部分的にしか相殺できないとし、必要なのは包括的な戦略だと強調。ドイツ政府は立地条件に関する提案を検討中で、検討の結果については現時点で予断を許さないという。

• ドイツで法定健康保険制度の急増する費用に上限を設ける法案が提案されたことを受け、米製薬大手イーライリリー は既に６月に同国への計画投資額２３億ユーロ（２５億７０００万ドル）を半減すると表明している。

item.title: Shares stumble, oil rises as investors await AI sector earnings
item.description: Asian stocks retreated broadly on Tuesday while oil prices rose as geopolitical risks rattled sentiment ahead of key results from AI bellwether companies.
item.dc:creator: Rocky Swift
item.content:encoded: Asian stocks retreated broadly on Tuesday while oil prices rose as geopolitical risks rattled sentiment ahead of key results from AI bellwether companies. The euro recouped some losses from the previous session that were spurred by escalating riots in France. Crude prices resumed their climb as markets weighed an executive order from US President Donald Trump that waived some sanctions and tariffs on Russian energy. The spotlight is on corporate earnings, with investors seeking fresh evidence that consumers and the broader economy remain resilient. Quarterly earnings are due from SpaceX and Netflix on Tuesday, with results from AI heavyweights such as Meta (META.O) and Tesla (TSLA.O) scheduled for later in the week. "The market is happy to cover shorts and unwind defensive trades, but that's very different from having the conviction to rebuild aggressive exposure to AI," Chris Weston, head of research at Pepperstone, said in a note. "French sovereign risk is clearly being priced into European equities, but the euro's resilience suggests traders aren't yet treating it as a systemic European problem." The MSCI Asia ex-Japan index (.MISX00000PUS) fell 1.14%, while Japan's Nikkei 225 (.N225) dropped 0.98%. South Korea’s KOSPI (.KS11) tumbled 3.92%. In early European trade, the pan-region Euro Stoxx 50 futures slipped 0.57%, German DAX futures dipped 0.33% and FTSE futures lost 0.47%. US stock futures, the S&P 500 e-minis , rose 0.12% to 7,743.5. The dollar index , which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies, fell 0.16% to 101.80, with the euro up 0.17% at $1.1229. The Japanese yen strengthened 0.16% to 158.24 per dollar, and sterling rose 0.21% to $1.3327. Overnight, French authorities set [USN:L6N4650BY TEXT:"curfews"] in parts of several cities including Paris, Lille and Nice, after a weekend of riots and looting stemming from nationwide anti-government protests. And in the Middle East, dozens were killed and more than 200 were injured after an [USN:L1N46509O TEXT:"attack"] by the Iran-aligned Houthis on a government security forces training camp in Yemen's Shabwa province. EARNINGS AND AI MAJORS IN FOCUS Netflix is expected to report slowing revenue growth in the third quarter, while SpaceX is forecast to report $12.74 billion in quarterly revenue. General Motors (GM.N) , Hasbro (HAS.O) , Halliburton (HAL.N) , and 3M (MMM.N) are among the more established names due to report on Tuesday. Along with quarterly results, markets are increasingly focused on the massive spending plans of the major AI players. Facebook operator Meta is one of five AI hyperscalers expected to increase combined capital expenditure to about $1.2 trillion next year, according to Goldman Sachs. "Investors are fine with AI being used more. What they're questioning is whether every dollar of AI capex earns more than it costs to finance," said Ninghui Liu, head of investment strategy and research for APAC at State Street Investment Management. "AI has gone from an earnings story to a balance-sheet story, and now a unit-economics story to some extent." Shares in South Korean AI infrastructure company Elice Group (0158S0.KQ) plunged nearly 30% below their initial public offering price in their market [USN:L1N466008 TEXT:"debut"], after the firm raised 201.1 billion won ($151.12 million) in an IPO. US crude rose 0.18% to $103.85 a barrel and Brent rose to $109.64 per barrel, up 0.08% on the day. Spot gold rose 0.13% to $4,145.25 an ounce. An executive [USN:L4N46600B TEXT:"order"] issued by Trump on Friday night waived key Russia-related US sanctions and tariffs, including duties on the country's goods and penalties for buying its oil and gas. However, Trump said on Saturday he has yet to announce a final decision on the matter. Inflationary pressures from elevated oil prices have put most major central banks on a tightening bias, though with a careful eye on whether economies are resilient enough to absorb higher interest rates. Recent comments from Federal Reserve officials, including Chair Kevin Warsh, suggest policymakers are in no rush to hike rates again. The US Census Bureau is due to release September figures, with housing starts expected to rise to 1.305 million from 1.275 million in August, while building permits are seen at 1.395 million compared with 1.403 million. European Central Bank policymaker Martin Kocher is due to speak later on Tuesday, as well as ECB policymaker and Finnish central bank governor Olli Rehn. Bank of England Monetary Policy Committee member Megan Greene will deliver a speech at the London School of Economics. In cryptocurrencies, bitcoin gained 0.22% to $82,117.01, and ether rose 0.63% to $2,413.64.

item.title: Micron union in Taiwan to launch strike as bonus dispute escalates
item.description: A union representing Micron Technology workers in Taoyuan, Taiwan, said it would launch a strike on Thursday to coincide with a mediation meeting between the US chipmaker and another collective representing workers at its Taichung operations, escalating a dispute over employee bonuses.
item.dc:creator: Wen-Yee Lee
item.content:encoded: A union representing Micron Technology (MU.O) workers in Taoyuan, Taiwan, said it would launch a strike on Thursday to coincide with a mediation meeting between the US chipmaker and another collective representing workers at its Taichung operations, escalating a dispute over employee bonuses. The strike raises the stakes in a labour dispute at one of Micron's most important manufacturing hubs, where it produces DRAM and high-bandwidth memory (HBM) chips, key components in AI servers. The Taoyuan union said the strike was intended to show solidarity with the Taichung union and to increase pressure on Micron to put forward a concrete profit-sharing proposal. Micron employs about 15,000 people in Taiwan, with separate unions representing workers at its Taoyuan and Taichung operations. The company has said it has invested more than T$1.6 trillion ($49 billion) on the island. Mediation between Micron and the Taoyuan union ended without an agreement in September. The union [USN:L6N45T0D9 TEXT:"secured authorisation"] from its members to strike in early October. The Taichung union, which represents workers at Micron's largest operation in Taiwan, remains in negotiations with the company. It has yet to hold a vote on whether to strike. The Taoyuan union did not specify how long the solidarity strike would last, saying it would release further details on Thursday. "Through our actions, we will make our dissatisfaction with the current system heard and demonstrate our determination to establish a fair profit-sharing system," the Taoyuan union said in a statement on Monday. Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te [USN:L1N461063 TEXT:"called last week"] for Micron and its workers to negotiate "sincerely". ($1 = 32.4940 Taiwan dollars)

item.title: China's September US soybean imports rebound from zero a year earlier, data shows
item.description: China imported 360,878 metric tons of US soybeans in September, up from zero a year earlier, as soybeans bought under a deal to end last year's trade war continued to arrive at Chinese ports.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China imported 360,878 metric tons of US soybeans in September, up from [USN:L2N3W102Q TEXT:"zero"] a year earlier, as soybeans bought under a deal to end last year's trade war continued to arrive at Chinese ports. Imports from Brazil fell 2.4% year-on-year to 10.7 million tons from 10.96 million tons in September last year, data from the General Administration of Customs showed on Tuesday China, the world's largest soybean buyer, [USN:L4N46007U TEXT:"brought in"] 11.88 million metric tons of soybeans in September, down 7.7% from the same month last year In the January-September period, soybean imports from the US fell 34% from a year earlier to 11.06 million tons, while shipments from Brazil rose 3.4% to 65.84 million tons Trade tensions between Beijing and Washington last year had prompted Chinese buyers to delay purchases of the previous US harvest until after an October summit between the two countries' leaders Following the meeting, Beijing [USN:L4N3YL08R TEXT:"purchased"] around 12 million tons of US soybeans, still well below levels from before the trade war China had also [USN:L1N4610ML TEXT:"purchased"] more than 60% of its 25-million-ton US soybean buying target for the 2026/27 marketing year, with shipments beginning in September, traders told Reuters last week

item.title: Activist investor Starboard builds stake in Solstice, urges focus on core business, FT reports
item.description: Activist investor Starboard Value has built a stake in Solstice Advanced Materials and is pushing the Honeywell spin-off to take steps to lift its share price, the Financial Times reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Activist investor Starboard Value has built a stake in Solstice Advanced Materials (SOLS.O) and is pushing the Honeywell spin-off to take steps to lift its share price, the Financial Times reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the matter. Starboard wants US speciality chemicals group Solstice to focus on execution in its core refrigerants and nuclear businesses and cut roughly $100 million in corporate overhead, the report said Starboard CEO Jeff Smith is expected to unveil the investment on Tuesday at the 13D Monitor Active-Passive Investor Summit, the report said Solstice and Starboard could not immediately be reached for comment outside regular business hours Solstice, which was spun off from Honeywell (HON.O) last year, makes specialty chemicals and materials used in industries, including semiconductor, refrigeration, nuclear power and healthcare The report comes months after Solstice and Element Solutions [USN:L4N44O21D TEXT:"scrapped"] their proposed $14.5 billion merger, citing shareholder feedback supporting the companies' standalone strategies Solstice shares nearly doubled in the months following its spin-off last October, but have since retreated sharply after the collapse of its proposed merger with Element Solutions, falling about 33% from a peak reached in May The stock is still up about 25% this year, valuing the company at $9.6 billion as of Monday's close

item.title: Rangers thrash Ducks, reach 6-0-0 at home for first time in 36 years
item.description: Rookie Dylan Garand made 29 saves, Oliver Bjorkstrand scored twice and the New York Rangers remained unbeaten at home with a 5-2 victory over the Anaheim Ducks on Monday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Rookie Dylan Garand made 29 saves, Oliver Bjorkstrand scored twice and the New York Rangers remained unbeaten at home with a 5-2 victory over the Anaheim Ducks on Monday night. The Rangers stopped their first losing streak of the opening weeks (0-1-1) and improved to 6-0-0 at home. New York has won its first six home games for the third time in team history and the first time since opening the 1990-91 season with a club-record eight straight home wins. Sean Durzi scored 1:18 into the contest, marking the second time in team history the Rangers scored within the opening two minutes of a third straight home game. J.T. Miller recorded a power-play goal 4:38 into the second before Gabe Perreault and Bjorkstrand scored in a span of 2:57 later in that period. Bjorkstrand finished off his second multi-goal game for the Rangers early in the third. It was his 23rd career multi-goal game. Alexis Lafreniere collected two assists, including a backhanded pass to Mika Zibanejad that led to Perreault's goal 10:17 into the second. Pavel Dorofeyev added an assist by setting up Durzi's goal on a night when he had five shots on target. Garand came within 69 seconds of his second career shutout before Nick Jensen and A.J. Greer scored late goals. The Ducks took their third straight loss and mustered little after peppering Garand at times in the opening 20 minutes. Anaheim also absorbed its first road loss (3-1-0) after extensive flight delays caused them to arrive at their hotel at around 2:30 a.m. ET. Anaheim backup goalie Ville Husso allowed five goals on 30 shots. Durzi opened the scoring when the Rangers maintained possession after Tye Kartye's shot from the left point hit the post. Kartye got his own rebound and sent the puck to Dorofeyev behind the net. Dorofeyev connected with Durzi for a shot from the right point that went by Husso, who was screened by Miller. Miller was left alone by Jackson Lacombe and Tim Washe in front of the net and easily deflected Fox's wrist shot for a 2-0 lead. Zibanejad threaded the puck through the slot for Perreault, who easily scored from the left edge of the crease into a vacated net with 9:43 remaining in the middle frame. After New York's Justin Dowling pressured Beckett Sennecke into a turnover along the right boards, Bjorkstrand gained possession in the middle of the slot and lifted the puck over Husso for a 4-0 lead. --Field Level Media

item.title: Japan yet to decide on defence budget funding, finance minister says
item.description: Japan has yet to decide on any specific means of funding a potential increase in defence spending, Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Tuesday, when asked about the possibility of a corporate tax hike as a source of revenue.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Japan has yet to decide on any specific means of funding a potential increase in defence spending, Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Tuesday, when asked about the possibility of a corporate tax hike as a source of revenue. "At this point, there is absolutely no specific method that has been decided," Katayama told a regular news conference, adding that the government is assessing the scope of defence capabilities required and the appropriate level of spending needed to achieve them. Kyodo News reported on Saturday that an additional corporate tax increase has emerged within the government as a possible source of funding for a planned defence budget expansion. Citing multiple government sources, the report said annual defence spending under the new defence strategy for the next five years is likely to exceed 10 trillion yen ($63.08 billion), up from about 9 trillion yen for the current fiscal year. Japan has been [USN:L1N46117W TEXT:"under pressure"] from the US to raise defence spending to 3.5% of GDP, which it has said should be a global standard for allies. ($1 = 158.5300 yen)

item.title: Long losing streak front of mind for Canucks as Hurricanes visit
item.description: The Carolina Hurricanes continue their five-game road trip, looking to pick up a second win over the Vancouver Canucks in as many weeks when the two teams hit the ice Tuesday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Carolina Hurricanes continue their five-game road trip, looking to pick up a second win over the Vancouver Canucks in as many weeks when the two teams hit the ice Tuesday night. Carolina is looking to return to the win column after Sunday's 3-2 loss to the Calgary Flames, which snapped the Canes' seven-game winning streak. "This is the no-one-feels-sorry-for-you league. We just regroup. We still created a ton of offense," said Hurricanes coach Rod Brind'Amour. "(The Calgary) game could have looked different, but I still would have felt the same, because we're giving up way too much." Jalen Chatfield and Jesperi Kotkaniemi scored while goaltender Brandon Bussi made 31 saves for the Canes, who are 5-1-0 on the road this season. Sebastian Aho added an assist in the loss and has points (six goals, eight assists) in all but one game to start the season. "We just probably gave up way too much," said forward Jordan Martinook. "It felt like, especially in the third, (Calgary) started putting it on us a lot and they were just playing simple, like how we usually play." The Hurricanes will be without forward Taylor Hall, who was placed on injured reserve Monday with an upper-body injury. The 34-year-old has three goals and two assists in eight games this season. Hall is considered week-to-week. Forward Mark Jankowski (lower body) was also sent home from the road trip for further observation. With Hall and Jankowski on the shelf, the Canes have recalled forwards Bradly Nadeau and Felix Unger Sorum from the American Hockey League's Chicago Wolves. Tuesday is the second and final meeting between Carolina and Vancouver this season. The Canes thumped the Canucks 7-2 in Raleigh on Oct. 8. Logan Stankoven paced the Hurricanes offense with a hat trick, Andrei Svechnikov added a pair, while K'Andre Miller and Jankowski also scored. Sean Walker added four assists in the win. Vancouver entertains Carolina following a six-game road trip, looking to snap a seven-game losing streak. Forward Elias Pettersson and Linus Karlsson scored in Saturday's 4-2 loss to the Tampa Bay Lightning. Goaltender Kevin Lankinen made 31 saves for the Canucks, who picked up just one of a possible 12 points on the road trip and haven't won since a 4-1 victory over the Calgary Flames on Oct. 3. "The execution of details within our game, things that we've continuously talked about that are just non-negotiable," said Canucks coach Manny Malhotra. "We need to have them to be able to be successful. Getting in shot lanes, being tougher around our net, face-off details. "We continue to learn the lesson the hard way that when you don't do those things, pucks end up in the back of your net." Forward Marco Rossi, who missed Saturday's contest in Tampa Bay due to illness, missed Vancouver's practice on Monday. Tuesday is the start of a three-game homestand for the Canucks, who are 1-2-0 on home ice this season. Carolina won both meetings with Vancouver last season, outscoring the Canucks 10-7. --Field Level Media

item.title: Trump warns Kansans that US will 'burn' like France if Democrats win
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Monday used violent unrest in France as an argument against Democrats in his battle to defend a Kansas Senate seat long held by Republicans but in danger of falling to his political opponents.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Steve Holland
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump on Monday used [USN:L6N4650BY TEXT:"violent unrest in France"] as an argument against Democrats in his battle to defend a Kansas Senate seat long held by Republicans but in danger of falling to his political opponents. Trump's rally on behalf of Republican incumbent Roger Marshall was his latest foray into conservative states where Republican candidates are on defense due to voter frustrations over the Iran war and rising prices. "I love you Kansas, but I'm here for a guy named Roger Marshall," Trump said. In a new addition to his stump speech, Trump pointed to widespread protests in France as a scenario that could erupt in the United States unless Republicans win. He provided no evidence. France in recent days has seen some of the worst unrest in years as huge protests over the cost of living and underfunded public services descended into riots and looting. Trump himself has struggled to make goods and services more affordable in the United States. In his speech, Trump turned to anti-immigrant and anti-Muslim rhetoric, the type that he used to fuel his three presidential campaigns. "We're not going to let that happen to this country," he said. "When you see burning steeples and raging fires in France, just remember that is what the radical Dumocrats want to do to America." Trump has been mocking Democrats by calling them Dumocrats. Rights advocates have [USN:L1N4620ZA TEXT:"repeatedly criticized"] Trump for his rhetoric over the years in which he has targeted and mocked immigrants and ethnic minority groups. Civil rights groups say such rhetoric normalizes discriminatory attitudes towards those communities. KANSAS COMPETITION Kansas, a conservative Midwestern state Trump won by 16 points in 2024, has not elected a Democrat to the US Senate in 94 years. First-term Senator Marshall is in a close fight with Democratic candidate Adam Hamilton, pastor of a Methodist megachurch, who is running against Trump’s tariff agenda and what he calls the president's “erratic leadership.” “He wants you to repent for being born White,” Trump said of Hamilton. Marshall, in remarks to the rally, led his campaign argument on cultural issues like stopping "radical Islam." He called Hamilton "too woke" for Kansas because he supports gay pride parades, which the crowd loudly booed. "We need someone who can sort heifers and steers," he said. In response, Hamilton's campaign spokesperson called Marshall's campaign "sinking." "Nothing said at the rally can distract from the fact Kansans are being crushed by rising gas and diesel prices, struggling to access affordable healthcare, and are tired of Washington corruption," the spokesperson, Tyson Brody, said. In a Monday video, Hamilton welcomed Trump to the state and said his supporters have “a place” in his campaign. Hamilton said he will work with Trump when it makes sense and stand up for Kansans when Washington policies hurt farmers and rural hospitals. The tightness of the race is emblematic of the challenges looming for Republicans in the November 3 midterm elections as they try to defy political headwinds and retain control of the Senate and the House of Representatives. Trump is deep into a 32-day campaign blitz, frequently going to friendly areas that he won handily in previous elections. One Republican familiar with Trump's midterm strategy said the president’s attention on rural parts of the country is in response to internal polling showing soft support from men 55 years and younger in rural areas nationwide, a voting bloc crucial to Trump’s 2024 presidential win. ECONOMIC CONCERNS The [USN:L6N46517O TEXT:"latest Reuters/Ipsos poll"], published on Monday, found that 31% of Americans approve of Trump's performance in office, a record low for the president. Democrats need a net gain of four seats in both the US House of Representatives and US Senate to overturn Republicans' narrow 218-214 and 53-47 majorities. In Park City, near Wichita, many rallygoers walked more than a mile across Interstate 135 to reach the rural arena, as a red-and-green truck stop sign flashed its latest prices above their heads: $3.98 for gas and $5.78 for diesel. That is up about 45% compared to average gas prices in the state last year, according to motoring club AAA. Economic concerns were palpable among Trump's most loyal supporters. “Being on disability, I don’t have much, but it seems like the prices are still going up and they need to come down. It feels like you’re having to search or hunt for food," said Monique Mullen, 59, a Republican voter from Hutchinson, Kansas, who takes care of her father. A small bloc of protesters gathered near the arena, including James Nightingale, a self-described independent from Halstead, Kansas. “I’m a farmer from Kansas and the Trump administration has decimated the farm economy in my area. Not only have his tariffs decimated our markets for grain sales, now he is bringing in imported beef from outside the country. What happened to ‘America First’?” he said. Kansans have proven a willingness to cross parties, as voters have elected a Democratic governor, Laura Kelly, for the last two terms. "I don't think it's ever easy to get elected here," said Gina Seman, a Trump voter from Towanda, Kansas, noting that Republican candidates in the past have taken their popularity for granted.

item.content:encoded:
相次ぐサイバー攻撃、金融機関にも「適切かつ迅速な対応促す」＝片山金融相 10:45 配信

写真は片山さつき金融担当相。8月3日、東京で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

Takaya Yamaguchi

［東京　２０日　ロイター］ - 片山さつき金融担当相は２０日、日本企業へのサイバー攻撃が相次ぐ現状を踏まえ、金融機関に対しても適切な対応を促す考えを示した。同日午前の閣議後会見で語った。

サイバー攻撃を巡り、金融機関には１０月９日に注意喚起を出していた。ただ、金融機関の委託先への不正アクセスを通じて個人情報が流出する事例もあり、片山金融相は「委託先などのリスク管理を含むサイバーセキュリティ対策も求めた」と述べた。

金融システムへの影響を未然に防ぐため、「サイバー攻撃の動向も踏まえながら、金融機関に対して適切かつ迅速な対応を促していく」としている。

item.title: Merger Monday channels old economy vibes
item.description: Daiichi Life's offer for Challenger, valuing the annuities giant at $5.7 bln, is one of five new or updated deals Down Under. Waste management, plumbing, coal and car leasing round out the tie-ups. For all the AI hype, established industries are bankers' bread and butter.
item.dc:creator: Antony Currie
item.content:encoded: What are investment bankers to do after the high-profile flop of the IPO billed as Australia's biggest this millennium? With egg still fresh on their faces from the implosion of AI neocloud [USN:L6N45V00W TEXT:"Firmus Technologies' $5.5 billion aborted"] debut, dealmakers kicked off Monday with five new or updated chunky takeovers. Old economy vibes remain the fee pool's bread and butter as tech and geopolitical turmoil roil global markets. Chief among them is a bid from Daiichi Life's (8750.T) Australia unit, TAL Daiichi Life Australia Pty, for the 80% it doesn't already own of Challenger (CGF.AX) . It values at some A$8 billion ($5.7 billion) the equity of Australia's largest annuity provider, whose board is considering the offer. The target, which provides a steady income for retirees in a country with an ageing population, is the antithesis of a data centre bet pumped up by AI exuberance. TAL's return on investment, including the initial stakes it bought last year, would only be around 6.4%, using estimated net operating profit for the 2028 financial year supplied by LSEG. That'd only rise to 7.2%, Breakingviews calculates, if the buyer, a Down Under stalwart for decades before Daiichi bought in 15 years ago, could cut a fifth of its target's expenses, which may be a stretch. But at least both are above Challenger's 5.8% cost of capital, per LSEG. The day's other new corporate marriage has actually benefitted from global volatility: coal. Miner New Hope (NHC.AX) is buying the remaining 74% it doesn't hold of unlisted smaller rival and neighbour Malabar Resources for A$1.3 billion ($907 million): the price of the polluting fossil fuel is up 25% since the US and Israel started their war against Iran. The acquirer is issuing shares to finance the purchase. But the new stock is barely a sixth of the value of what Firmus was aiming to sell and it is all going direct to Malabar investors. Of those two new deals, the only one of Firmus' underwriters that secured a role was Bank of America, advising TAL and Malabar. Rounding Monday's merger mania off was progress on three private equity plays for decidedly ho-hum industries: Pacific Equity Partners-owned SG Fleet won the four-way battle for FleetPartners (FPR.AX) , offering A$1.1 billion ($768 million) for its vehicle fleet management rival's shares. Brookfield appears to have secured plumbing firm Reliance Worldwide (RWC.AX) at a A$4.1 billion ($2.86 billion)enterprise value after a go-shop period ended with no other bidders. And EQT (EQTAB.ST) has all but sealed its first big purchase Down Under, agreeing after months of negotiations to buy waste management specialist Cleanaway (CWY.AX) at a A$9.3 billion ($6.5 billion) enterprise valuation . Of course, there's no guarantee any of these transactions get done: for example, Reliance's top shareholder is AustralianSuper, which late in the process scuppered [USN:L4N3D24GI TEXT:"Brookfield's pursuit of Origin"] Energy (ORG.AX) in 2023. And while the five deals could between them shovel A$350 million in fees into investment banks' coffers, assuming an average 1.5% rate, none on their own would match the A$215 million Firmus would have forked over. But there is perhaps no greater tonic for a failed AI deal than a retreat to the real world. Follow Antony Currie on Bluesky and LinkedIn . Daiichi Life's Australian business, TAL Daiichi Life Australia, has offered to buy the 79.5% of Challenger it doesn't already own in a deal that values the Australian annuity provider's equity at A$8.1 billion, the target revealed in a regulatory filing on October 19. The offer represents a premium of almost 20% to Challenger shares' closing price on October 16. Also on October 19, New Hope said it would buy the 74% it doesn't already hold of rival, unlisted coal miner Malabar Resources, in a deal valuing its equity at A$1.8 billion. New Hope will issue shares to Malabar investors to fund the transaction. Several other already announced transactions also progressed on October 19: private equity firm EQT and waste management company Cleanaway agreed to a deal that values the latter's enterprise at A$9.3 billion; SG Fleet, which is wholly owned by buyout shop Pacific Equity Partners, won the battle to take fleet-management rival FleetPartners private at an equity valuation of A$1.13 billion; and the go-shop period for Reliance Worldwide has ended, leaving Brookfield's A$4.1 billion offer a month ago for the plumbing group's enterprise as the only one standing. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: GCash owner Mynt edges higher in record Philippine IPO amid Asian selloff
item.description: Shares of fintech firm Mynt , operator of mobile wallet GCash, rose 1.7% in their market debut on Tuesday after the company raised 60.9 billion pesos ($966.99 million) in the largest-ever initial public offering in the Philippines.
item.dc:creator: Yantoultra Ngui, Karen Lema, Roshan Thomas
item.content:encoded: Shares of fintech firm Mynt (GCASH.PS) , operator of mobile wallet GCash, rose 1.7% in their market debut on Tuesday after the company raised 60.9 billion pesos ($966.99 million) in the largest-ever initial public offering in the Philippines. The stock opened at 6.63 pesos a share, up from its offer price of 6.60 pesos, before rising further to 6.71 pesos. The broader Philippine Stock Exchange index (.PSI) was down 0.02%. The firm's debut demonstrated investor demand for Mynt's payments business even as a [USN:L4N466020 TEXT:"broader selloff"] in AI-related shares made investors more selective about new tech listings. "It is a record and, more importantly, a statement of confidence in Mynt, in the Philippine economy and in the strength of our capital market," Philippine Stock Exchange President and Chief Executive Officer Ramon Monzon said. Mynt's listing came as South Korean AI firm Elice [USN:L1N466008 TEXT:"fell sharply"] in its market debut on Tuesday, highlighting a more cautious mood toward companies tied to the AI boom. Mynt President and CEO Martha Sazon said the listing marked a new stage in the company's effort to widen access to financial services for Filipinos who have long been outside the formal banking system. Nearly 90% of GCash customers come from low- to middle-income households, she said. Mynt, backed by Globe Telecom (GLO.PS) , Ant Group and Ayala Corp (AC.PS) , owns GCash, the Philippines' largest finance app, according to its prospectus. The platform offers payments, money transfers, lending, savings, investments and insurance products. The company had 41.5 million monthly active users in the three-month period that ended on June 30, or nearly 56% of the Philippines' adult population, according to its prospectus. GCash users completed payment transactions worth 9.84 trillion pesos in the first half of 2026. BIGGEST IN THE PHILIPPINES Mynt's IPO surpassed Monde Nissin's (MONDE.PS) 52.2-billion-peso IPO in 2021 to become the largest-ever IPO in the Philippines, according to data compiled by LSEG. Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. said the listing came at a time when the stock market needed renewed investor interest and broader participation, adding that attracting fresh capital remained a challenge. He said strong demand from local and international investors offered a "reason for optimism" and reflected continued confidence in Filipino enterprises. The Mynt IPO attracted more than 20 cornerstone investors, who committed about $500 million, or nearly 60% of the base deal, according to the company. Investors included BlackRock, Citadel, Fidelity International and the International Finance Corp. Mynt sold 8.03 billion shares at 6.60 pesos each. The exercise of an overallotment option increased the deal size to 60.9 billion pesos from 53 billion pesos. Mynt plans to use the proceeds to fund growth in its digital financial services business, product development and general corporate purposes, according to its prospectus. Mynt said that for the six-month period that ended on June 30, its net income rose 7.3% from a year earlier to 10.82 billion pesos. Revenue rose 10.4% to 43.27 billion pesos. item.title: GCash owner Mynt's shares inch higher after record Philippine IPO
item.description: Mynt, the operator of mobile wallet GCash, raised about US$966.99 million after selling over 8 billion shares.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Business

GCash owner Mynt's shares inch higher after record Philippine IPO

Mynt, the operator of mobile wallet GCash, raised about US$966.99 million after selling over 8 billion shares.

Traders work on the trading floor of the Philippine Stock Exchange, in Taguig City, Metro Manila, Philippines. (File photo: Reuters/Eloisa Lopez)

FAST

Shares of fintech firm Mynt, operator of mobile wallet GCash, rose 0.5 per cent in its market debut on Tuesday (Oct 20) after the company raised 60.9 billion pesos (US$966.99 million) in the largest initial public offering on record in the Philippines. The stock opened at 6.63 pesos per share, up from its offer price of 6.60 pesos. The Philippine Stock Exchange index was down 0.2 per cent. Mynt sold 8.03 billion shares at 6.60 pesos each. The exercise of an overallotment option increased the deal size to 60.9 billion pesos from 53 billion pesos. The offering comprised both primary and secondary shares. Proceeds from the sale of new shares will go to the company, while proceeds from the secondary shares will go to existing shareholders, according to the IPO prospectus.

The offering surpassed Monde Nissin's 52.2-billion-peso IPO in 2021 to become the largest IPO on record in the Philippines, according to LSEG-compiled data. The IPO attracted more than 20 cornerstone investors, who committed about US$500 million, or nearly 60 per cent of the base deal, according to the company. Investors included BlackRock, Citadel, Fidelity International and the International Finance Corp. Mynt plans to use the proceeds to fund growth in its digital financial services business, product development and general corporate purposes, according to its prospectus. Mynt, backed by Globe Telecom, Ant Group and Ayala Corp, owns GCash, the Philippines' largest finance app, according to its prospectus. The platform offers payments, money transfers, lending, savings, investments and insurance products. The company had 41.5 million monthly active users in the three-month period ended June 30, nearly 56 per cent of the Philippines' adult population, according to its prospectus. GCash users completed payment transactions worth 9.84 trillion pesos in the first half of 2026. Mynt reported net income of 10.82 billion pesos for the six-month period ended Jun 30, up 7.3 per cent from a year earlier. Revenue rose 10.4 per cent to 43.27 billion pesos.

item.title: 城内経財相、今月の日銀会合も「都合つけば出席」 利上げけん制改めて否定
item.description:
Yoshifumi Takemoto
［東京 ２０日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Yoshifumi Takemoto

［東京　２０日　ロイター］ - 城内実経済財政相は２０日の閣議後会見で、２９－３０日に予定されている日銀の金融政策決定会合に都合がつけば出席したいと述べた。同時に、自身が日銀の利上げをけん制したとの一部報道を改めて否定し、今後、議決延期請求を行う可能性があるかとの質問には「高市早苗内閣は日銀の自主性を最大限尊重している」と回答した。

城内氏は１６日の会見で自身が日銀の利上げをけん制し議決延期請求を検討したとの毎日新聞報道を否定していたが、その後、改めて同紙が同様の内容を掲載したことに対し、利上げを止めるために議決延期請求権の行使を検討したことはないと反論した。自身に対して取材がなかったと強調した。

８月以降の米株市場の不安定な動きについては、「世界のＧＤＰ（国内総生産）の４分の１を占める米国経済は世界・日本経済に大きな影響がある」として「その動向を注視する」との考えを示した。

今年は世界で４番目となっている日本の名目ＧＤＰが来年は６位に転落するとのＩＭＦ（国際通貨基金）の見通しについて、ドル建ての名目ＧＤＰに一喜一憂せず成長戦略の実現などに注力すると語った。

item.title: Gold inches up on softer dollar as investors assess Fed rate outlook
item.description: Gold inched higher on Tuesday, helped by a softer US dollar, as market participants looked ahead to next week's Federal Reserve policy meeting for clues on the future path of interest rates.
item.dc:creator: Sukanya Mitra
item.content:encoded: Gold inched higher on Tuesday, helped by a softer US dollar, as market participants looked ahead to next week's Federal Reserve policy meeting for clues on the future path of interest rates. Spot gold was up 0.1% at $4,145.22 per ounce by 0347 GMT, while US gold futures for December delivery rose 0.1% to $4,164.70. "The interesting dynamic is that there's going to be a big move, no matter what the Fed does, and the initial reaction... might be supportive of gold if they keep interest rates unchanged," said Kyle Rodda, senior financial market analyst at Capital.com. Recent comments from [USN:L6N462084 TEXT:"Fed"] officials signalling little [USN:L1N4600EO TEXT:"urgency"] for further policy tightening have tempered expectations of a rate hike at the central bank's October 27-28 policy meeting. According to CME's FedWatch Tool, traders are pricing in an 82% chance that the Fed will leave rates unchanged next week, but expectations for a hike in December remain at 89%. Higher interest rates typically weigh on gold prices because they increase the opportunity cost of holding bullion, which does not pay interest. The US dollar index (.DXY) softened on Tuesday, making greenback-priced bullion more affordable for buyers overseas. Rodda said a de-escalation of tensions in the Middle East and a decline in oil prices could provide a further boost to gold prices. Oil prices advanced on Tuesday, with Brent hovering around a [USN:L1N46601X TEXT:"five-month high"] as traders priced in a geopolitical risk premium after Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis [USN:S8N44M08Y TEXT:"said on Monday"] they carried out several attacks against Saudi energy, airport and military targets. Elsewhere, [USN:L1N465004 TEXT:"Bank of Japan"] Governor Kazuo Ueda said underlying inflation is "quite close" to the central bank's 2% target, with strong global AI demand adding to inflationary pressure from a tight job market, signalling scope for further rate increases. Among other metals, spot silver rose 0.7% to $57.48 per ounce, platinum gained 0.7% to $1,651.25 and palladium fell 0.2% to $1,117.87.
